Leaving the area affected or the expiration of the Anti-Magic invocation will restore all aura based magic items. skills and effects to the previous nature. Only one spell (Anti-Divinity) can be cast or exist within the area affected. Anti-Magic and Anti-Divinity affect all spells and invocations (respectively) except each other.

This invocation surrounds an object or place with a very strong negative energy field attuned against a single race, class, alignment or any combination thereof. Object: Once every 10 seconds when the object touches a being it is attuned against; the being must make a Magic Resistance or die. Beings whom the object is attuned against can feel a sense of danger within sixty feet of the object and can sense the object as the source if they can see it. Place: The location's size can be no larger than one 10' x 10' x 10' area per Piety Control of the invoker. Beings whom the place is attuned against can feel a sense of danger within one hundred feet of the area and can sense the area as the source if they can see it. Beings in the area affected must make a Magic Resistance once per 10 seconds or perish.

This invocation creates a great concussive force that blasts outwards from the epicenter. The effect of the blast on beings and structures depends upon their location within the area affected: 1' radius per 2 Piety Control: 1d10 smashing damage per 2 Piety Control of the invoker to 4d4 randomly selected body areas. Beings caught in this area affected are thrown away from the Center a distance of 1 foot per Piety Control and lose 10 seconds of action while recovering from the blast. (Subtract 1 foot from total distance thrown per 50 pounds of weight). 2' radius per 2 Piety Control: 1d8 smashing damage per 2 Piety Control to 2d4 randomly selected body areas. Beings affected are knocked over and lose 1d6+1 seconds of action regaining a standing position. 3' radius per 2 Piety Control: 1d6 smashing damage per 2 Piety Control to 1d4 randomly selected body areas. Beings must make an Agility save or be knocked over requiring 1d6+1 seconds to regain a standing position. Ignore the overlap between the areas affected (treat the effects as separate rings around the epicenter). A successful Magic Resistance by beings trapped in the blast reduces damage by half. The following spells and invocations provide protection against this invocation: Invulnerability, Wall of Power, Sphere of Power, Spirit Wall and Spirit Sphere. However, each of the indicated sphere and wall spells and invocations has a 1% chance of shattering per Piety Control of the invoker. Walls of Protection and Spheres of Protection will nullify the magic of Divine Blast within their affected area.

Allows the invoker to perform a final act of retribution at the time of death in the name of their deity. The invoker's spirit is transformed into divine energy, resulting in a Divine Blast equal in magnitude to the invoker's Piety Control. Any being sacrificing themselves in this manner cannot be Recovered, Resurrected, Reincarnated or in any way brought back to life, except by a Wish or Miracle. This invocation can be invoked at any time prior to death, triggering only when the invoker dies. If the invoker is within an Anti-Divinity affected area at the time of death, then none of the effects of this invocation occur.

Causes the invoker to transform into a Fire elemental form of a strength matching their Piety Control. When the invocation ends, the invoker reverts to normal form retaining all injuries received while in Elemental Fire Form. If the invoker dies in Elemental form the corpse reverts back to normal form.

Creates a huge swarm of flying, stinging insects, roughly spherical in shape. that is controllable by the invoker. The swarm can move up to 15' per second and anyone caught within the swarm will take 1d4 points of damage to all non-protected areas (armor slits and eye-holes count as unprotected areas.) Each 10 seconds of exposure to the swarm. a Poison Resistance is made against a collective poison effect or an additional 1d4 poison damage per 2 Piety Control to the neck and 1d8 damage per 2 Piety Control to the upper torso will occur, resulting in inflammation of the respiratory system. At the end of the duration, the insects vanish. The invoker must direct the swarm, and can invoke no other invocations, cast spells, or take offensive action. If they does so, the swarm will act freely and attack the nearest being indiscriminately. The swarm cannot be stopped except by fire, fog or smoke. Fog or smoke will cause the insect swarm to land and fall into a subdued state for as long as the presence of the fog or smoke lasts. Every die of fire damage reduces the swarm radius by 1'. If the radius reaches zero, the swarm has been consumed.

This invocation binds an unattached soul (Ghost, etc.) to a soulless body, allowing the soul to manipulate the body as if it were alive. Any physical based skills use the attributes of the body while any mental based skills (such as Thought Projection) use the attributes of the soul. Involuntary muscle movements such as blinking and breathing do not occur, as the body itself is not really alive. While the body may not have an active respiratory or circulatory system, the body is magically preserved such that no obvious signs (such as a stench or decay) indicate that the body is not alive. Natural healing of wounds does not occur, but the affected being ignores physical fatigue and pain. However, a minimal sleep cycle of 2 hours each day is needed to prevent mental fatigue. The being is considered to be supernatural and can be banished per the skill Banish, leaving the body on the earthly plane and sending the soul off to the nether planes.

An individual affected by Slow Death enters an unconscious hibernation like state, causing all life-threatening effects to be considerably slowed. All bleeding, poisons and diseases are slowed such that their effects only occur once per day instead of at their regular time interval. Even the moment of death is no longer instantaneous as death takes one full hour before the body dies and the soul departs.

Summons an Fire Elemental of a strength and capability that depends on the Piety control of the invoker. The Fire Elemental is not automatically under the control of the invoker. At the end of the invocation duration or if the elemental takes lethal damage, it returns to its home plane.

Causes the earth to tremble and shake, damaging buildings, and causing fear and uncertainty to those unfamiliar with its effects. The first 40 seconds of the Earthquake has no measurable effect as the power of the Earthquake builds. After the initial buildup, the effects are as follows: Epicenter: structures suffer 10d8 structural damage per 10 seconds of the quake. All non-flying individuals will be thrown to the ground. A 1% chance per 2 Piety Control of the invoker exists that the ground breaks open beneath the invoker's enemies, who will suffer 10d6 crushing damage per 10 seconds after falling in. After one minute of falling into an earthquake fissure, beings will begin to suffocate. Morale checks are required at -50% or Game Master Characters flee in random directions. 2) 1/2 mile per 2 Piety Control of the invoker from the epicenter: structures take 8d6 structural damage per 10 seconds of the quake. All individuals must make an Agility save once per 10 seconds or be thrown to the ground. Morale checks are required or GMCs flee in random directions. 3) 1 mile per 2 Piety Control of the invoker from the epicenter: structures take 4d6 structural damage per 10 seconds of the Earthquake. 4) 10 miles per 2 Piety Control of the invoker from the epicenter: tremors from the quake can be felt. 5) 100 miles per 2 Piety Control of the invoker from the epicenter: beings with Depth Knowledge can feel the rumblings of the earthquake and can determine the approximate direction to the epicenter. Ignore the overlap between the areas affected (treat the effects as separate rings around the epicenter.) Buildings constructed to withstand earthquakes as well as reinforced buildings of high-quality manufacture suffer only 1/2 damage from the earthquake.

At the cost of one Will Force for each time invoked, Extend Life enables the invoker to lengthen life span. While the invocation does not make the invoker any younger, it does prevent the invoker from aging for a time equal to the age extension listed. Once the age extension period is over, the invoker ages at twice the previous aging rate. Usage: 1st casting grants an additional 100 years, aging x2 afterwords. 2nd casting grants an additional 10 years, aging x4 afterwords. 3rd casting grants an additional 1 year, aging x8 afterwords. 4th casting grants an additional 1 month, aging x16 afterwords. 5th casting grants an additional 1 week, aging x32 afterwords. Multiple invocations are allowed, but the usefulness of such is limited by the law of diminishing returns.

This invocation extends the duration of another invocation such that the duration has no end. However, invocations with an instantaneous duration cannot be made permanent. Permanency does not affect invocations that are already permanent. When an invocation becomes permanent, the invoker no longer has the option of ending the invocation. The cost varies by the divine effect being made permanent from 1/2 to 4 Will Force. Some invocations may not be made permanent (GM discretion).

This invocation allows travel to other planes. In order to transport separate (non-carried) gear to or from another plane, a Will Force save is required for each object. At 20+ Piety Control, the invoker can plane shift to another location on the same plane (as teleportation). The laws of physics and metaphysics can operate differently on different planes. Without precautions plane shift can lead to a quick end. However, beings who are slain while not on their home plane are not permanently dead. Instead, they are plane shifted back to their home plane where all injuries are removed and one Will Force rating point is permanently lost.

This invocation speeds along a recently departed soul (from the time of death up to 1 hour) to a vessel that will be the container of its next life. The soul is reborn at the time of birth within the new vessel immediately somewhere else within the same plane. The form of the vessel is somewhat determined by chance but may be influenced by the invoker (the category may be adjusted by one in either direction for every 4 Piety Control of the invoker): Forms vary randomly from (Insect/Arachnid through animals and up to humanoid or magical servant). The invoker may choose the form within the category. The soul loses its sense of self, including all previously known abilities when it is reincarnated within the new form. Beings that have a totem animal may ignore the above table and reincarnate as their totem animal.

Creates a localized, violently destructive funnel-shaped windstorm with the following dimensions: Base is 10 ft. diameter per 2 Piety Control. Height is 100 ft. per 2 Piety Control. Top of the tornado measures 20 ft. diameter per 2 Piety Control. The vortex moves with a velocity of 25 mph per 2 Piety Control. BEINGS are affected by the tornado according to their proximity to the funnel: 1) Within 100' per 2 Piety Control of the invoker, air pressure is destabilized, reducing non-magical flight to gliding. In addition to being deafened. All beings must make a Strength save or be pulled closer to the tornado. 2) Beings caught in the tornado wall have their visibility reduced to 0. Due to the high velocity within the vortex, any item as small as a pebble striking a being deals 2 points of thrusting damage per 2 Piety Control. Physical armor provides no protection: only magical armor provides full protection. For every 10 seconds in the vortex wall, 3d4 pieces of debris will strike a human-sized being. (Adjust the debris number according to the nonhuman-sized being's height: +1 additional piece of debris per +1 ft. -1 pieces of debris per -1 ft). 3) Any being surviving the vortex wall and finding themselves in the vortex center will be subjected to a vacuum force (make Strength save at -50% if attempting to hold on to an anchored handhold every 10 seconds while in the center). The vacuum will lift the being to the top of the tornado where the being will be ejected, and they will then be subjected to falling damage equal to the tornado's height. STRUCTURES: and other permanently stationed objects like rooted trees are affected by the tornado in the following ways: 1) Within 100' of the tornado, foliage will have leaves and weak branches torn away. 2) Structures and other non-flexible objects within 10' of the tornado are subject to 1 point per Piety Control of cutting damage per 10 seconds of exposure. Large semi-flexible objects (such as trees) within 10' of the tornado are subject to 1 point of cutting damage per 2 Piety Control per 10 seconds of exposure. 3) Within the tornado wall, buildings and other permanently places objects (such as statues) are subjected to 10 points (1 structural point) of cutting damage per 2 Piety Control per 10 seconds. Semi-flexible fixtures are subjected to 1/2 the amount. When the tornado subsides, any debris that was held aloft will be dropped to the ground. Anyone or anything surviving within 100' per 2 Piety Control of the subsided tornado is subject to crushing damage from falling debris (to be determined by the GM). Atmospheric variables including heavy cloud cover, plentiful moisture and rapid temperature changes must be present in order to create and sustain the Tornado. The direction of the Tornado can be controlled by the Control Weather invocation or a successful Weather Lore skill roll. The tornado can be retracted into the clouds and emerge elsewhere within the area affected, taking 30 seconds to accomplish.

Causes all invocations invoked within the 5 cubic feet per Piety Control to be reflected back at the originator. Missile weapons of a divine nature or affected in any way by an invocation will also turn back upon their originator. If Turn Divinity likewise affects the originator, then the results are random (see reflection rules at the beginning of the Magic section).
This powerful invocation allows the invoker to create divinely magical items. This is not handled directly here but the results can be added in item customization in equipment section of this sheet.

This is by far the strongest invocation a mortal being may invoke, allowing the invoker to have their greatest desires realized. With power such as this, there are a few caveats: 1) No Miracle can create a true paradox (two people in the same Place at the same time, an endless time loop, etc.). 2) A Miracle can be used to invoke a combination of non-memorized invocations with a combined Piety Level of up to two times the Piety Control of the invoker. 3) Each Miracle permanently decreases the Will Force rating of the invoker by one. (A Miracle cannot increase a Will Force rating). 4) A Miracle may affect no more than 1 being per 2 Piety Control of the invoker. 5) No more than one sentence may be used to state the Miracle. That sentence may have no more than two of these connecting words: “if”, “and”, “nor”, “or”, and “but”. 6) All outcomes of a Miracle are decided upon at the discretion of the Game Master. The invoking time of Miracle is equal to the time necessary to speak the miracle. The invoker's deity can veto any Miracle (interpreted by the GM).

An infectious disease is implanted within a carrier targeted by the invoker along with a method for the transmission of the disease. The next 5d10 people per Piety Control of the invoker that comes in contact with the disease carrier must make a Disease Resistance or contract the disease. If Cure Disease is used upon the carrier, future contamination from the carrier will cease. Once the full amount of people have been infected, no further people will be infected by the disease (the disease will vanish as each remaining case runs its course). The type of disease and method of transmission (water, food, insect, airborne) must be approved by the GM.

The winds of divine magic blow firmly amidst the ruins of one structure (such as a crumbled castle, a rotten ship or a smashed statue) specified by the invoker. As the invocation is invoked, a Shimmering surrounds the rubble and splinters and magically reconstructs the object to its former glory, filling in areas even if material is missing. The Will Force rating for the invoker is permanently reduced by one, if the effects of this invocation occur. No furnishings are fixed or replaced (a door counts as part of the structure, a chair counts as a fixture).

The winds of erosion gust violently against one structure (such as building. statue, ship or archway) specified by the invoker. During the invoking time of the invocation, the structure miraculously seems to fast-forward in time until it remains just a ring of splinters and rubble. The Will Force rating for the invoker is permanently reduced by one if the effects of this invocation occur.

Causes the invoker to transform into a semi-transparent humanoid, glowing with a light equal in color to the invoker's alignment. The Spirit Form has the following characteristics: 1) Highly physical attribute ratings (16+1d4). 2) Thought Projection at 75%. 3) Each hand has 10 seconds of action and can strike with fists (once per 4 seconds) for 1d4 points of smashing damage per 2 Piety Control of the invoker or use any weapon proficiently. 4) Can magically hear and see, and can Life Sense at 100%. 5) 3 Endurance for each body area per Piety Control of the invoker 6) Non-magical damage is reduced to 1/2. 7) Spirit Armor at the Piety Control of the invoker. 8) If good, the glow acts as Blessed Light invoked at the invoker's Piety Control. If evil, the glow acts as Cursed Darkness invoked at the invoker's Piety Control. When the invocation ends, the invoker reverts to normal form retaining all injuries received while in Spirit Form. If lethal damage is received while in Spirit Form, the invoker's corpse reverts back to normal form.

Creates a swirling wall of air around the target 2' from their body. The being in the airwall is -5 to hit with weapons and -5 to be hit by weapons. All Intelligence based magical attacks are at -25% when passing through (into or out of) the airwall. The wall cannot be moved. All Listen rolls for the target are at -50% due to the noise of the airwall.
Adds +5% to Poison Resistance and +5% to Disease Resistance per 4 Piety Control.

Makes it much easier to locate an object, being or place, giving a +50% bonus to any form of Scrying (or location effects) versus the affected target. It can be cast on a single being or a stationary area no larger than a 5' radius per Piety Control. If cast on a being with Non-Detection, the effect will fail.
The next attack for the focus being will be an automatic critical fumble.

Allows the invoker to detect and discern the nature of all diseases in an area equal to a 5 foot radius per Piety Control. The invoker also knows the transmission method (contact, airborne or ingestive).

The invocation makes the individual very difficult to scry on. Any attempts to use the Scrying spell on the person fall, and the Scrying skill is at -5% per Piety Control. It can be cast on a single being or a stationary area no larger than 5' radius per Piety Control.

By touching another being, the invoker can determine if the being is under any form of mental control or possessed in some way. The invoker gets a brief glimpse of who is controlling the being, if the controller is visible and in sight of the controlled being, and does not have Non-Detection active.
Allows the invoker to detect the presence of poison in an area equal to a 5' radius per Piety Control. The invoker knows the potency, type, effect and transmission method (imbibed, etc.).
The focus being is temporarily blinded for the duration of the invocation and suffers all fighting penalties for total darkness.
All within the area affected must make a Magic Resistance or suffer the effects of the Deafen invocation. Invoker is not affected by this invocation.

Compels the target fanatical being to be resolved in their actions, causing them to ignore morale checks and shock. Furthermore, the affected being cannot be stunned or knocked unconscious for the duration.

This invocation must be targeted at an object or area under the influence of the invoker via an already established skill, invocation, or spell effect. This invocation will allow a word or phrase, limited to a number of words equal to the Title of the invoker, to be spoken by an individual to bypass the effects of a skill, invocation, or spell. Thus, safe passage could be given to individuals entering a cursed area or passing through a haunted grove as well as allowing passage through magical and divine walls and spheres. The Word of Passage must be spoken aloud by each being seeking safe passage through the area of effect. In order for this invocation to affect magic spells such as Seal and Set, the invoker would need to be the caster of the spell.

Creates a divine light glowing in a color appropriate to the deity within the area of effect. With the exception of the invoker, all living beings affected by the divine light must make a Magic Resistance save. Failure indicates that a being is afflicted with puckering wounds (one per 2 Piety Control) in random body areas. Each wound causes 2d4+ l points of magical damage per Piety Control of the invoker. A Magic Resistance made by more than 1/2 indicates no wounds appear on that individual. Success indicates only 1/2 the number of wounds appear. Small plants instantly die, medium plants wilt, and large plants lose foliage.

Creates a divine light glowing in a color appropriate to the deity within the area of effect. With the exception of the invoker, all living beings affected by the divine light are healed of wounds (1 per 2 Piety Control). Each wound is relieved of 2d4+1 damage per 2 Piety Control of the invoker. This invocation will not replace lost limbs. Small plants sprout, medium plants bloom, and large plants regain lost foliage.

This invocation creates a great divine concussion force that instantaneously appears at the exact target location blasting outward to a radius of 4' 2 per Piety Control of the invoker. Due to the powerful nature of the shockwaves produced, when cast on the surface a 1/4 strength Earthquake as per the invocation is also produced. A successful Magic Resistance save by beings within the blast radius of effect halve the amount of damage taken. Treat all damage inflicted as smashing with armor reducing damage accordingly. 1) 1' radius per 2 Piety Control. ld12 damage per 2 Piety Control to 4d4+4 random areas. Beings caught in this area of effect are deafened, knocked unconscious and thrown away from the center a distance of 3' per 2 Piety Control, sustaining appropriate falling damage. Subtract 1' from the total distance per 50 pounds of weight. There is a 5% chance per 2 Piety Control of the invoker that magical protections such as Sphere of Power, Wall of Power, Spirit Wall, or Spirit Sphere will be shattered, causing beings to be affected as if in area 3. 2) 2' radius per 2 Piety Control. ldlO damage per 2 Piety Control to 4d4 random areas. Beings caught in this area of effect are thrown away from the center a distance of 2' per 2 Piety Control, sustaining appropriate falling damage. Subtract I foot from total distance per 50 pounds of weight. There is a 4% chance per 2 Piety Control of the invoker that magical protections such as Sphere of Power, Wall of Power, Spirit Wall, or Spirit Sphere will be shattered, causing beings to be affected as if in area 4. 3) 3' radius per 2 Piety Control. ld8 damage per 2 Piety Control to 2d4 random areas. Beings affected are knocked over and lose ld6+1 seconds to stand. There is a 3% chance per 2 Piety Control of the invoker that magical protections such as Sphere of Power, Wall of Power, Spirit Wall, or Spirit Sphere will be shattered. 4) 4' radius per 2 Piety Control. I d6 damage per 2 Piety Control to ld4 random areas. Beings affected must make an Agility save or be knocked over, spending ld6+1 seconds to stand. There is a 2% chance per 2 Piety Control of the invoker that magical protections such as Sphere of Power, Wall of Power, Spirit Wall, or Spirit Sphere will be shattered. Damage from each area of effect radius is not cumulative. Spheres and Walls of Protection as well as Invulnerable beings are completely protected from the effects of the blast, but not from the effects of the Earthquake. The effects of Agility saves due to Divine Wrath and Earthquake are cumulative. If cast underground or underwater, a full strength Earthquake occurs.

Causes any ill effects inflicted upon the invoker to be inflicted upon the being causing such ill effects if they are within 1 mile per 2 PC. The being inflicting the ill effects may make a Magic Resistance save to avoid suffering each ill effect. Ill effects include any and all physical and mental ailments such as melee blows, magic effects, diseases and insanity. Only ill effects inflicted since the beginning of the invocation are mirrored in this way.
One specific scent is amplified, providing a +25% bonus to the Smell skill to follow or identify only that exact scent.

When cast on a being, this invocation masks all odors emitted by a being and carried possessions. When cast on an object, no odors are emitted by that object. Practitioners of the Smell skill have a 0% skill chance to detect the target of this invocation. The target of the invocation retains its own sense of smell.
Target being may hold their breath three times as long as normal without suffering asphyxiation.
Target being gains Infravision 60' for the duration.
Target being gains Far Sight for the duration.

Protects target beings from being attacked or targeted by spells, invocations and effects originating from Plant creatures. The plants must make a Control Resistance each time they wish to attack the being. Only sapient plants get a Control Resistance. The invocation will not work against magical plants. Protection from Plants cannot be invoked on a Plant creature.
The target's sense of smell no longer functions. The target's Smell skill is reduced to 0% (after all modifiers).

Protects target beings from being attacked or targeted by spells, invocations and effects originating from Animal creatures. All animals must make a Control Resistance each time they wish to attack the being. Only sapient animals get a Control Resistance.  The invocation will not work against magical animals. Protection from Animals cannot be invoked on an Animal creature.
The being can locate objects by flicking their tongue out repeatedly. The tongue acts as a receptacle, collecting heat signatures of objects within range.

Protects target beings from being attacked or targeted by spells, invocations and effects originating from Slime creatures. All slimes must make a Control Resistance each time they wish to attack the being. The invocation works automatically versus lesser slimes (1-4 level), but greater slimes (5-8, get a Control Resistance. The invocation has no effect on arch slimes. Protection from Slime cannot be invoked on a Slime creature.
The target being gains a +25% bonus to Smell skill.
Causes one plant, sapient plant or magical plant to be held immobile for the duration of the invocation. Only sapient and magical plants are allowed a Control Resistance.

Protects one target beings from being attacked or targeted by spells, invocations and effects originating from Magical Plant creatures. The plants must make a Control Resistance each time they wish to attack the being. Only sapient and magical plants get a Control Resistance. Protection from Magical Plants cannot be invoked on a Magical Plant creature.

Restores one point of object strength per Piety Control to the targeted non-magical leather object. Unless the invoker successfully makes an appropriate social skill roll for the item being repaired, it will be quite obvious that the item was repaired by an unskilled person. Any repaired area will be barren of any creative detail. However, an appropriate successful social skill roll indicates the item repaired will appear as if it had never been damaged.
Causes one animal, sapient animal or magical animal to become rigid and immobile for the duration of the invocation. Sapient and magical animals get a Control Resistance.
The target being's load limit and encumbrance limits are doubled.

Protects target beings from being attacked or targeted by spells, invocations and effects originating from Magical Animal creatures. All animals wishing to attack the being must make a Control Resistance each time they wish to attack. Sapient and magical animals get a Control Resistance. Protection from Magical Animals cannot be invoked on a Magical Animal creature.

Restores one point of object strength per Piety Control to the targeted non-magical wooden object. Unless the invoker successfully makes an appropriate social skill roll for the item being repaired, it will be quite obvious that the item was repaired by an unskilled person.  Any repaired area will be barren of any creative detail. However, an appropriate successful social skill roll indicates the item repaired will appear as if it had never been damaged.

The willing recipient of this invocation need not be concerned for food or water during the duration. If Sustenance is cast on a being that has been affected by this invocation within a number of days equal to the time of the previous duration, then the being affected must make a 1/2 Vitality save to avoid becoming fully fatigued.
The invoker strikes the ground with a weapon, foot or fist. All bipedal beings (except the caster) must make an Agility save to remain standing. All animals within the area become spooked.

A sculpture or carving of a creature becomes animated. If the object is a complete likeness of an animal, the animal will have full movement capabilities.  The creature is not alive and does not have any powers or abilities. Using this invocation, a staff with a snake's head could be transformed into an animated snake with full movement. Likewise, a carving of a lion's head on a shield would allow the lion's head to snap at combatants in which the wielder is engaged. In order to repair damage, magic items need Mend or Repair cast upon them, non-magic items may use Mold and appropriate social skill for the material type (Metalworking, etc.).

Causes one Slime per 2 Piety Control to obey the mental commands of the invoker. Lesser slimes are automatically controlled while greater slimes get a Control Resistance. Arch slimes cannot be controlled.

Target being gains the movement rate of a cheetah (Walk: 15/150/15, Jog: 30/300/30, Run: 45/450/45, Sprint: 60/600/60 ). Beings that already run as fast as a cheetah are unaffected by this invocation.

The invoker causes one animal to increase in size dependent on Piety Control. Comparative strength will be acquired by the increase in size (GM discretion). Possessions and objects on the animal do not change size. Affects both animal and magical animal creature types.
Causes targets Magical Plants obey the mental commands of the invoker. Normal plants are automatically controlled while sapient and magical plants get a Control Resistance.

Causes one humanoid or magical humanoid to become rigid and immobile for the duration of the invocation if a Control Resistance is failed. Beings affected by this invocation can still breathe. A new Control Resistance (with a cumulative +5% modifier) is made every 10 seconds to break free of the invocation.

Restores two points of object strength per Piety Control to the targeted non-magical metal object. Unless the invoker successfully makes an appropriate social skill roll for the item being repaired, it will be quite obvious that the item was repaired by an unskilled person.  Any repaired area will be barren of any creative detail. However, an appropriate successful social skill roll indicates the item repaired will appear as if it had never been damaged.
The Strength rating of the target being is raised to 18 for the duration. Beings that already have an 18 or higher Strength rating are not affected by this invocation.
The Vitality rating of the target being is raised to 18 for the duration. Beings that already have an 18 or higher Vitality rating are not affected by this invocation.
The Agility rating of the target being is raised to 18 for the duration. Beings that already have an 18 or higher Agility rating are not affected by this invocation.

Creates one section per Piety Control of the invoker of a 10' x 10' x 6“ wall composed of densely packed earth. If any being is standing within the area where a section of the wall is being created, then that section will fail to appear. The wall has an object threshold of 15 and an object strength of 5 per Piety Control.
Causes one Magical Animal to obey the mental commands of the invoker. Normal animals are automatically controlled; sapient and magical animals get a Control Resistance.

The Intelligence, Wisdom and Knowledge ratings of the target being are set to 5. At the end of the duration, the Intelligence, Wisdom and Knowledge ratings of the target return to their previous values.

Causes one Humanoid or Magical Humanoid to obey the mental commands of the invoker. The being will not do anything which would put it in danger or go against its alignment and will get a new Control Resistance if asked to do so.

As long as partial cloud cover exists, the invoker can form a thunderhead to devastate an area with hail. All beings in the area affected are pelted with 2d4 hailstones. Each hailstone inflicts 2d4 damage per 5 Piety Control. Hailstorm cannot be invoked indoors or underground.

The area affected becomes superheated and molten. Any beings within the area affected begin sinking into the ground. Any exposed body area coming in contact with the boiling earth is inflicted with 5d6 damage per 10 seconds in the form of blisters and burns. At the end of the duration, the boiling earth cools to its normal temperature, effectively trapping all affected within the area of effect. Any submerged beings will begin to asphyxiate. Must be cast on soft ground such as earth or sand.  Has no effect on hard ground such as stone.

Causes a pit the size of the area affected with a depth of 3' per PC of the invoker to form just underneath the top-most layer of the ground. While the area appears to be firm and solid, any non-flying being within 3' of the center of the effect must make a 1/2 Agility save.  Similarly, any being within the remaining diameter must make an Agility save. Success indicates the being was able to jump clear of the sinkhole. Failure indicates the being has fallen to the depth of the sinkhole, taking appropriate falling damage.  Once the invocation has been triggered, the thin layer of ground covering the sinkhole collapses into the hole. Likewise, the magic holding back the earthen walls ceases, causing the hole to be filled, effectively burying anyone trapped within.  Beings that are buried alive begin to asphyxiate. Cannot be cast on a rocky surface. If cast underwater, any beings within the diameter area of effect as well as any within a height equal to the PC of the invoker must make a 1/4 Agility save to avoid being forcefully sucked into the sinkhole, suffering the ill effects described above.

Protects one being per 2 Piety Control from being attacked or targeted by spells, invocations and effects originating from Animal, Magical Animal, Plant, Magical Plant and Slime creatures. Greater slimes, sapient and magical animals and sapient and magical plants get a Control Resistance. The invocation has no effect on arch creatures.  Protection from Nature cannot be invoked on an Animal, Magical Animal, Plant, Magical Plant or Slime creatures.

Works as the invocation Control Weather but effects will last for an entire season once the invocation is complete. It can be set to a certain time pattern as well, making it rain for a few hours or making it clear during certain hours regardless of the usual weather. Multiple invokings can create exceptional or truly horrendous weather depending on the invoker's desire. There may be unintended consequences to other areas around the changed climate. For instance, if it is made to rain every day for several hours, then clouds may not form in other nearby regions. Continuous rain would bring flooding and quickly destroy a region. It would also require more and more of the natural condensation from other regions to keep up the rain.

Allows the invoker to sense the exact location of corpses, both humaoid and animal. The invoker closes their eyes and concentrates for 1 minute. At the end of the minute, they open their eyes and are able to sense any corpse within the area affected, even through non-magical walls, barriers, earth, and stone. This invocation does not grant the user any information about corpses other than their location. The invoker cannot detect corpses infused with negative life force (undead), with this invocation.

Causes 1 corpse per 2 Piety Control of the invoker to be rapidly and completely mummified. All liquid is removed from the corpse, the internal organs are completely destroyed, and the body decays at a rate of 1 overall Endurance per 1,000 years. Mummies created with this invocation are not undead.

Allows a being to fly in any direction at 3' per Intelligence per second. The being must maintain concentration while flying and must make Intelligence saves to successfully change direction or make any difficult moves. If concentration is broken, the being will fall. The being's base Endurance is reduced by 1 point per minute while flying. Beings cannot fight, cast spells, or use invocations during flight.

When invoked upon a container or object under 10' in any dimension, any corpse placed into or on top of the object will be perfectly preserved in the condition in which it was placed. Magical and divine magical containers and objects are not affected by this invocation.
Causes the invoker to make a target's life force appear opposite of what it actually is (i.e., positive life force appears to be negative).

Causes one being to drop all items held due to severe muscle spasms, which continue for the duration of the invocation. The target must make an Agility save to remain standing and has no control over movement during convulsions. This invocation has no effect on beings without both muscle and bone structure.

A bind wound effect (healing of 1d4+1 Endurance) occurs on all wounded body areas, including bruises. Areas already affected by the act of binding wounds are ignored for this invocation. This invocation cannot be used along with binding wounds to produce cumulative healing.
Allows a target to see through mundane, magical and divine magical darkness. The target's overall Endurance is reduced by 1 per 10 seconds while using this invocation.

Causes the target's muscles to rapidly contract, causing damage to 1 randomly determined non-vital limb, such as an arm or leg. If the being fails a Vitality save, Endurance in the affected area is reduced to 0 and the bone is broken. If a Vitality save is successful, the body area takes 3d4 smashing damage in the form of a bruise. This invocation has no effect on beings without both muscle and bone structure.

Raises the target's Strength by 1 point per 4 Piety Control, while the target's Vitality is reduced by the same amount. At the end of the duration, the target's Strength returns to its previous value, while the temporarily lost Vitality returns at a rate of 1 point per hour.

Injuries to a single body area are redistributed over a number of body areas in immediate proximity. The number of body areas where wounds are diffused to is equal to 1 per 2 Piety Control. As soon as an injury is inflicted, the wound is evenly redistributed to other body areas. The redistribution of the injuries remain even after the invocation ends; the damage does not revert back to the area hit.

Immobilizes 1 spiritual being for the duration of the invocation. A new Control Resistance with a cumulative +5% modifier is made every 10 seconds to break free. Beings with a Will Force of 20 or higher are unaffected by this invocation.

Masks the target's life force completely to those who can detect life force. Anyone actively Life Sensing will not detect the affected target, and is not afforded an Illusion Resistance to see past the disguise.

Creates 1 section per Piety Control of a 10'x 10' wall composed of darkness. If any being is standing within the area where a section of the wall will appear, that section does not appear. Beings cannot see or hear through the wall. This invocation may only be destroyed by the invoker or Dispel Divinity.

Creates 1 section per Piety Control of a 10'x 10' wall composed of light. If any being is standing within the area where a section of the wall will appear, that section does not appear. Beings cannot see or hear through the wall. The light is incapable of blinding, and each section illuminates up to 40' away from each side. This invocation may only be destroyed by the invoker or Dispel Divinity.

Removes all sunlight in the area affected, resulting in a dark, shadowy expanse. The area affected can still be illuminated using a mundane lightsource such as torches or with magical effects such as the skill Light.

Places the target in a death-like state. Respiration and circulation are halted, and no muscle movement can occur. The target loses the senses of smell, touch, and taste, but can still hear and see. Wounds do not bleed, and the target is immune to poison and disease while in this death-like state.
Causes a dibilitating illness to fall upon the target, lowering Strength and Vitality ratings by 1 point per 4 Piety Control of the invoker.

Creates a repugnant stench of rotting flesh in the affected area, and all beings entering must make a Vitality save at -10% per 5 Piety Control of the invoker or become nauseated, resulting in a -1 per 5 Piety Control penalty to hit and a +1 per 5 Piety Control penalty to Initiative. This invocation only affects those with an olfactory sense.

Instantly and permanently removes all form of mental control over the target. The target receives a new Control Resistance, but is afforded a modifier based on the invoker's for every 2 Piety Control of the invoker, the recipient receives a +5% bonus to Control Resistance for ongoing controlling effects.

Causes bone to become brittle and crack, inflicting 1d4+1 damage per Piety Control to 1 targeted body area of a skeletal undead creature or creature with exposed bone, or a loss of 2 points of object strength per Piety Control to a bone object.

Enhances the chance for the afflicted being (or corpse) to be converted to a physical undead. Once cast upon a being, any skill used to raise its corpse as a physical undead receives a +5% bonus per Piety Control to the chance of success. Any saves the target makes against spells, invocations, and other effects are lowered by 2% per Piety Control of the invoker.

Protects against conversion to physical undead, granting a bonus of +5% per Piety Control to any saves the invoker makes against being raised as a physical undead. Spells, invocations and effects have a 2% chance per Piety Control of the invoker to fail (bonus to resists). In addition, any skill used to raise the invoker as a physical undead receives -5% per Piety Control to the skill roll. In either case, if the skill roll or effect succeeds, despite the penalties, the invoker is raised as a physical undead as normal.

Creates a 10'x10'x10' per 4 Piety Control area in which corpses will not decay. Bodies are perfectly preserved in the condition in which they enter the affected area. This invocation does not stop time in the area; it merely prevents bodies from decaying.

Repairs broken and damaged bone, healingf 1d4+1 damage per Piety Control to 1 targeted body area of a skeletal undead creature or creature with exposed bone, or restoring of 2 points of object strength per Piety Control to a bone object. Bone cannot be restored past its original Endurance or object strength with this invocation.

Creates an area of diffuse negative life energies, in which all natural plants cease living and decay at 5 times the normal rate. Soil becomes infertile and water is made fetid and stagnant. Living creatures from the largest animal to the smallest insect leave the area. Positive life force beings feel uneasy and must make a Will Force save to enter the affected area. This invocation has no effect on Magical Plants, Magical Animals, and Slimes.

Creates a sphere of glowing light within the area affected. The sphere is centered on a fixed location, but is not mobile and will not move from the location where it is created. The light is able to blind creatures with night vision. Additionally, all undead and negative life force beings take 1d6 damage per 4 Piety Control of the invoker as soon as they enter the affected area and every 10 seconds thereafter.

Creates an area of diffuse positive life energies, in which all natural plants grow at 5 times the normal rate up to complete maturity (i.e. sprouts will grow into trees, but the trees will not age beyond maturity and begin to decay). Grasses are lush and green, and all fruit-bearing foliage produces fruit of the highest quality. If invoked in a newly-sewn field, the crop will yield 30% above normal. Negative life force beings are dealt 1d4 points of damage per Piety Control per hour to all areas while on Living Ground. This invocation has no effect on Magical Plants.

Negates the effects of natural sunlight penalties for a light-sensitive or undead target, but also reduces the target's overall Endurance by 1 for every 15 minutes spent in the sun. This invocation does not negate effects of magical or divine magical light such as Brilliance and True Day.

Creates a sphere of darkness within the area affected which negates all forms of vision to all within the sphere, including the invoker. The sphere is centered on a fixed location, but is not mobile and will not move from the location where it is created. All beings in the area affected must successfully make a Magic Resistance or be blinded, even after stepping out of the sphere, for 1 hour per Piety Control.
Allows the invoker to take mental control of one Death Elemental. The invoker may command the elemental to return to its home plane using this invocation.
Allows the invoker to take mental control of one Life Elemental. The invoker may command the elemental to return to its home plane using this invocation.

Causes the invoker's hands to be charged with a chilling, dark energy. The first being touched must make a Magic Resistance or take 2d4 cold damage per 4 Piety Control, and a second Magic Resistance or be paralyzed for 10 seconds per 4 Piety Control of the invoker. The target must also make a Control Resistance or temporarily lose 1d4 Will Force per 6 Piety Control of the invoker.

Enhances the chance for the afflicted being (or corpse) to be converted to a spiritual undead. Once cast upon a being, any skill used to raise its corpse as a spiritual undead receives a +5% bonus per Piety Control to the chance of success. Any saves the target makes against spells, invocations, and other effects are lowered by 2% per Piety Control of the invoker.

Causes the target to suffer a heart attack for 1 minute, inflicting 6d6 damage to the upper torso. During the heart attack, the target may not take any action for 1d4 minutes. Once the heart attack ends, the target must make a Vitality save or permanently lose 1 point from their Vitality rating.

Protects against conversion to spiritual undead, granting a bonus of +5% per Piety Control to any saves the invoker makes against being raised as a spiritual undead. Spells, invocations and effects have a 2% chance per Piety Control of the invoker to fail (bonus to resists). In addition, any skill used to raise the invoker as a spiritual undead receives -5% per Piety Control to the skill roll. In either case, if the skill roll or effect succeeds, despite the penalties, the invoker is raised as a spiritual undead as normal.

Creates a sphere of darkness within the area affected which negates all forms of vision, including the invoker's. The sphere is centered on a fixed location, but is not mobile and will not move from the location where it is created. All positive life force beings within the sphere are temporarily drained of 1 Will Force point per 10 seconds.

Creates a sphere of glowing light within the area affected, blinding creatures with night vision, even the invoker if applicable. The sphere is centered on a fixed location, but is not mobile and will not move from the location where it is created. All negative life force beings within the area of effect are temporarily drained of 1 Will Force point per 10 seconds.

Creates 1 section per Piety Control of a 10'x 10'x 3' translucent, dark wall of pure negative life force. The wall sections will grow out of 1 surface and magically attach to other surfaces they encounter. If any being is standing within the area where a section of the wall is being created, the section will fail. Any living being within 1' of the wall per Piety Control will take 1d4 points of damage per Piety Control per minute to all areas until it moves out of the wall's area of effect. Negative life force beings within the same distance will be healed at a rate of 1d4 points per Piety Control per minute to all wounded areas and can pass through the wall freely. Living beings with a Will Force lower than 15 cannot pass through the wall, but those with a 15 or higher Will Force can pass through if a Will Force save is made at -5% per Piety Control of the invoker.

Creates 1 section per Piety Control of a 10'x 10'x 3' shimmering wall of pure positive life force. The wall sections will grow out of 1 surface and magically attach to other surfaces they encounter. If any being is standing within the area where a section of the wall is being created, the section will fail. Any undead or negative life force being within 1' of the wall per Piety Control will take 1d4 points of damage per Piety Control per minute to all areas until it moves out of the wall's area of effect. Positive life force beings within the same distance will be healed at a rate of 1d4 points per Piety Control per minute to all wounded areas and can pass through the wall freely. Negative life force beings with a Will Force lower than 15 cannot pass through the wall, but those with a 15 or higher Will Force can pass through if a Will Force save is made at -5% per Piety Control of the invoker.

Causes an undead being to be held in near null time. An undead creature in Isolation is incapable of action (physical or mental), but at the same time is unable to be physically or mentally harmed or moved. If the invoker targets a flying undead being, the undead will be held in mid-air, immobile and unaware of events around it. Time for the undead being in Isolation is slowed to 1 second of action per year. Undead in Isolation are unable to use touch effects or drain attacks. This invocation can only be removed by the invoker or Dispel Divinity.

Causes the physical body of an undead being to be completely restored to its original form, removing all physical damage and decay. This invocation will not prevent future damage or further decay. This invocation has no effect on living beings.

Creates a sphere of darkness within the area affected which negates all forms of vision, including the invoker's. The sphere is centered on a fixed location, but is not mobile and will not move from the location where it is created. All beings within the sphere begin to choke, losing 1d6 overall Endurance per 10 seconds. At the onset of asphyxiation, a Will Force save must be made to remain calm or damage is doubled. When Endurance has been reduced to 0, a being appears very pale and must make a Vitality save every 5 seconds to remain conscious (-5% to the save for every point below 0). Once Endurance reaches a being's negative Vitality rating, the lungs have collapsed and the heart stops beating. One minute later, if Endurance is not raised above the negative Vitality rating, the being dies.

Creates an area in the shape of a sphere where both light and darkness are suppressed, resulting in a shadowy, gray world, devoid of light or darkness. The sphere is centered on a fixed location when created and cannot be moved. Neither the living nor the dead receive any bonuses or penalties within the affected area. True Day and True Night will override True Twilight if invoked at a higher Piety Control.

Enhances the chance for the afflicted being (or corpse) to be converted to a souled undead. Once cast upon a being, any skill used to raise its corpse as a souled undead receives a +5% bonus per Piety Control to the chance of success. Any saves the target makes against spells, invocations, and other effects are lowered by 2% per Piety Control of the invoker.

Protects against conversion to souled undead, granting a bonus of +5% per Piety Control to any saves the invoker makes against being raised as a souled undead. Spells, invocations and effects have a 2% chance per Piety Control of the invoker to fail (bonus to resists). In addition, any skill used to raise the invoker as a souled undead receives -5% per Piety Control to the skill roll. In either case, if the skill roll or effect succeeds, despite the penalties, the invoker is raised as a souled undead as normal.

When this invocation is called down upon an undead creature, it creates an exact living duplicate of the target (including attributes, equipment, skill ability, and powers), with the following conditions: The alignment of the duplicate is diametrically opposite of the alignment of the target. The duplicate has the unwavering compulsion to destroy the target being, forcing the target's Soul and/or Spirit to pass on. The duplicate being carries exact replicas of every item, magical or otherwise, that the target being is carrying or wearing. Any items on the target being that inflict damage using negative lie force will use positive life force when used by the duplicate. Fighting and other skills of the duplicate may be used differently than that of the target being. The duplicate is immune to all death-based magics and draining effects. Both the duplicate and the target beings are spirit shifted during the conflict. Other beings attempting to interfere with an instance of this invocation receive their own Judgment (if living) or Living Judgment (if undead). If the target being wins the duel, the duplicate and all effects (including damage dealt by the duplicate) from the contest vanish. If the duplicate wins, the target is banished and its Soul and/or Spirit is permitted to move on to a higher or lower plane. This invocation has no effect on undead creatures without a Spirit or Soul.

Creates a sphere of true day, even at night, brightened with natural sunlight. All beings within the sphere are affected as if it were day. All effects which are dependent upon sunlight or daytime apply, regardless of the actual time. Thus, within a sphere of True Day, a Lesser Vampire who is normally active at night will be immobilized and burn from sunlight as if it were actually exposed to the sun. True Twilight and True Night will override True Day if invoked at a higher Piety Control.

Creates a sphere of true night, even during the day, covering the affected area with the darkness of night. All beings within the sphere are affected as if it were night. All effects which are dependent upon darkness or nighttime apply, regardless of the actual time. Thus, a Lesser Vampire, normally debilitated during daylight hours, would function as normal while inside the sphere. The sphere is centered on a fixed location when created and cannot be moved. True Twilight and True Day will override True Night if invoked at a higher Piety Control.
Grants immunity to electricity, fear, frost, and hold to the invoker for the duration of the invocation.

Creates a circle of concentrated negative life energy. Beings sustained by negative life force, such as undead, gain the following while in the Circle of Death: Healing at the rate of 1d6 per 4 Piety Control per minute to all injured areas. Will Force is regained at the rate of 1 per minute up to the creature's maximum (Will Force Containers are not filled by the Circle of Death). Any positive life force effects currently affecting the being are negated. Furthermore, beings sustained by positive life force are affected by the Circle of Death as follows: Must make a Will Force save at -5% per Piety Control of the invoker to enter the circle. Once inside, Will Force is drained at a rate of 1d6 per 10 seconds. When its Will Force reaches 0 or it is slain through other means, the being will immediately rise as an appropriate undead of the Game Master's choosing. Corpses placed within a Circle of Death for 1 hour will rise as an appropriate undead of the Game Master's choosing at the end of the hour. If a Circle of Life is already present in the same general location at the time of invoking, the Circle of Death will fail. A Circle of Death and a Circle of Life cannot overlap. The invoker may only have one Circle of Death in effect at any given time. If the invoker creates a second Circle of Death, the first is destroyed and the second comes into being.

Creates a circle of concentrated negative life energy. Beings sustained by positive life force (i.e. living beings) gain the following while in the Circle of Life: Healing at the rate of 1d6 per 4 Piety Control per minute to all injured areas. Automatically cured of all non-magical poisons. Limbs are regenerated as per the invocation Regeneration. Disease and Poison Resistances are raisedbyto +30% for 1 hour per Piety Control of the invoker, and those already suffering from poison or disease are afforded a new modified Resistance roll. Furthermore, beings sustained by negative life force, such as undead, are affected by the Circle of Life as follows: Must make a Will Force save at -5% per Piety Control of the invoker to enter the circle. Once inside, Will Force is drained at a rate of 1d6 per 10 seconds (this does not affect Will Force Containers). When their Will Force reaches 0 or they are slain through other means, undead beings with neither Soul nor Spirit are permanently destroyed. If a souled or spiritual undead is reduced to 0 Will Force, its Soul and/or Spirit is released and affected as the skill Call of the Light. If a Circle of Death is already present in the same general location at the time of invoking, the Circle of Life will fail. A Circle of Life and a Circle of Death cannot overlap. The invoker may only have one Circle of Life in effect at any given time. If the invoker creates a second Circle of Life, the first is destroyed and the second comes into being.
Grants immunity to death-based magic, transformation of form, and Will Force draining to the invoker for the duration of the invocation.

Causes a written command to be empowered with a controlling force. Prior to using this invocation, the invoker insribes a written command on any surface using any implement desired (ink, blood, etc.). Once the command is inscribed, the invocation may be used. The command has the following effects: Living beings reading the command must make a Control Resistance. Failure results in the individual(s) performing the command without question. Sentient undead or negative life force beings must follow the command without question. The command works on a given being once, regardless of Control Resistance success or failure. The individual reading the command must be able to read the language in which it is inscribed. This invocation has no effect on non-sentient undead. The command may not contain instructions that would cause the victim to directly harm themselves. If the GM determines that following the command would directly bring harm to the victim, the invocation fails.

Causes a very strong field of positive life force to surround an undead being. The undead must make a Magic Resistance or be permanently and irrevocably destroyed. The Magic Resistance of the undead is negatively modified by 5% for every 4 full points of Piety Control of the invoker. This invocation has no effect on living beings.

Causes the invoker to transform into a Death elemental form of a strength matching their Piety Control. When the invocation ends, the invoker reverts to normal form retaining all injuries received while in Elemental Death Form. If the invoker dies in Elemental form the corpse reverts back to normal form.

Causes the invoker to transform into a Life elemental form of a strength matching their Piety Control. When the invocation ends, the invoker reverts to normal form retaining all injuries received while in Elemental Life Form. If the invoker dies in Elemental form the corpse reverts back to normal form.

Summons an Death Elemental of a strength and capability that depends on the Piety control of the invoker. The Death Elemental is not automatically under the control of the invoker. At the end of the invocation duration or if the elemental takes lethal damage, it returns to its home plane.

Summons an Life Elemental of a strength and capability that depends on the Piety control of the invoker. The Life Elemental is not automatically under the control of the invoker. At the end of the invocation duration or if the elemental takes lethal damage, it returns to its home plane.

Creates a swarm of flying, stinging, undead insects, roughly spherical in shape, that is controllable by the invoker. Dead insects within range are infused with negative life force and begin to fly towards the invoker. The swarm can fly up to 15' per second, and anyone caught within the swarm takes 1d6-2 points of damage per insect bite to all non-protected areas (armor slits and eye-holes count as unprotected areas). Every 5 seconds of exposure to the swarm, the victim receives 3d6 insect bites per 5 Piety Control, and each bite requires a Poison  Resistance to avoid paralysis in 1d10 seconds, lasting 1d4 minutes per 5 Piety Control. The invoker must first apply Control Undead to the swarm, or the swarm will attack the first being it senses with Life Sense. The sound of the insects' buzzing wings acts as the ability Insanity Voice, and all listeners must make a Will Force save or suffer from a type of Insanity. The swarm has the following powers (at will): Contanimate Water, Path Find, Putrefy Food, and Tarnish. The swarm is immune to non-undead specific Control, Death-Based Magic, Disease, Fatigue, Fear, Frost, Hold, Illusion, Mind, Poison, Shock, and Transformation of Form. If fire is used against the swarm, every die of fire damage reduces the swarm by 1'. When the swarm's radius reaches 0, it has been destroyed.

Causes the invoker's hands to become surrounded by a dim red glow. The next being touched must make a Magic Resistance or suffer a Blood Reave. Blood Reave causes the following effects: An open wound is created on the target being where the invoker touched him. This initial wounding does 2d6 damage, which can only be healed through magical means. The target's blood begins to gush forth from the wound. The victim loses 1 point of base Endurance per Piety Control of the invoker. Individuals reduced to 0 base Endurance in a vital area fall to the ground as a lifeless husk, while beings reduced to 0 base Endurance in a non-vital area lose use of the area. All lost Endurance is added to the base Endurance of the invoker on a 1 for 1 basis. The invoker's Endurance cannot be raised above twice its normal value. The invoker will lose this added Endurance at the rate of 1 per minute. This invocation cannot target an undead being and has no effect on beings without blood.

Grants the invoker the ability to detect the exact temperature of a being, object, or area no larger than 1 cubic foot per Piety Control. A being who wishes to resist their temperature being known is afforded a Magic Resistance.

This invocation causes 1 item of food to be preserved for 1 week per Piety Control. Once the duration has expired the food begins to decay normally. This invocation has no effect on living plants or beings.
A steady wind of 10 to 15 (9+1d6) miles per hour gusts through an area causing small and light objects to be tossed about.
All non-magical flames in the affected area are extinguished. If the object being extinguished is being held by another being, they are allowed a Magic Resistance to avoid the effects, if they wish.
Encases the target in a thin layer of illusionary magical ice. For every 4 Piety Control of the invoker, the affected being or object takes 1 less die of damage from all cold-based attacks.

The speed of the affected being's next melee or missile attack is reduced by 2 seconds. Speeds cannot be reduced below minimum weapon speed. This invocation lasts until an attack is made by the affected being.

The target being receives the following bonuses per 5 Piety Control of the invoker: +5% to Agility saves, -1 Initiative, and -1 weapon speed (not to go below minimum weapon speed). The affected being does not fatigue while the invocation is in effect, but afterward suffers 1 level of fatigue per 5 Piety Control of the invoker.
The affected being's next melee or missile attack receives a +3 bonus to hit.
Beings knocked unconscious or who have had the wind knocked out of them have these effects removed. Refocus has no effect on sleeping beings.
Allows the affected being to travel on top of water, liquid or marshy ground as if it were solid ground.

Encases the target in a thin layer of illusionary magical flames. For every 4 Piety Control of the invoker, the affected being or object takes 1 less die of damage from all heat and fire-based attacks.
The nerve endings of the affected being are numbed, granting immunity to Shock. The recipient also takes 2 less points of damage from each physical blow.

The target being must make a normal Agility save when first affected or fall down. For the duration of the invocation, the target suffers the following penalties: -10% to Agility saves, +2 initiative, and -2 to hit.

Prevents the affected being from being knocked off-balance (as per the Combat term) as long as no weapon longer than 3 feet is being wielded. Martial Knowledge and Martial Lore combat effects (damage, distance, etc.) are granted a +1/+5% bonus per 5 Piety Control. This invocation also grants the recipient a +5% bonus to the skill Balance per 5 Piety Control of the invoker.

Provides 1 magical layer of physical armor, considered flexible (layer 1), with an armor rating of 1 per Piety Control. This magical armor will appear below any clothing or armor already worn (layer 1), and weighs 2 pounds per Piety Control. All armor layering rules still apply. If the armor created by this invocation is removed, it disappears and the invocation is dispelled.

Encases the target in a thin layer of illusionary magical electricity. For every 4 Piety Control of the invoker, the affected being or object takes 1 less die of damage from all electricty-based attacks.

Allows the invoker to summon 2 spiritual rowers for each Piety Control of the invoker. These rowers will row at the direction of the invoker at up to maximum strength and speed for the duration of the invocation. Any spiritual rower damaged in anyway disappears immediately.

Creates a sphere of wind protection around the invoker in which all movement of natural wind and carried particulate matter is reduced to 0. Magical wind effects entering the sphere become a contest of effects against the invoker to enter the area of protection.

A steady wind of 10 to 15 (9+1d6) miles per hour gusts through an area causing small objects to be tossed about. Every 10 seconds (including the moment the invocation manifests) the invoker can attempt to control the direction of an already established magical storm effect such as Storm of Dust or Storm of Fire. A contest of magic occurs between the parties involved. If the invoker wins the contest, they can either control the direction of the storm or cause it to dissipate entirely.

Increased reflexes allow for an additional -1 to weapon speed, -1 to defensive adjustment, and an additional Agility save whenever one is required. The target may always roll the second Agility save, taking the better of the two results.
Locks the target onto its current plane. Any attempt to plane walk, phase, etc., by the target being dispels the effect if a contest of Piety is won against the practitioner.
Encases the target in a thin layer of illusionary magical acid. For every 4 Piety Control of the invoker, the affected being or object takes 1 less die of damage from all acid-based attacks.

Allows the invoker to summon 2 spiritual crew for each Piety Control of the invoker. These spiritual beings will crew any ship or vessel within sight of the invoker. They will follow the instructions of the invoker and do the general crew tasks of sailing a ship, manning the helm or steering, rowing a boat, etc. Sailing and other applicable skills for all spiritual crew is 5% per PC of the invoker. They are considered to have 1 Agility per Piety Control of the invoker. At 12 or higher Piety Control a navigator can be summoned as one of the crew. That navigator has a 5% Navigate skill per Piety Control of the invoker. At 16 or higher Piety Control gunners/spotters can be summoned as part of the crew. The spiritual gunners attack skill matches the attack skill of the invoker. At 20 PC the gunner/spotters attack skill exceeds the invoker's attack skill by one level higher unless already at master attack skill. Any spiritual crew damaged in anyway disappears immediately.

Provides 1 magical layer of physical armor, considered flexible (layer 1), with an armor rating of 2 per Piety Control. This magical armor will appear below any clothing or armor already worn (layer 1), and weighs 2 pounds per Piety Control. All armor layering rules still apply. If the armor created by this invocation is removed, it disappears and the invocation is dispelled.

Creates an invisible sphere of protection around the invoker that moves with the invoker. All bodies of water within the area of effect become placid (even and without movement). The effects of wind are reduced or removed. Specifically, winds of 40 miles per hour or less or removed altogether at the will of the invoker and winds of higher speeds can be reduced up to 40 miles per hour. The invoker cannot otherwise control or change the direction of the wind entering the protected sphere using this invocation.

Surrounds the target being with a sphere of constant temperature comfortable to the affected being. Cold and fire-based effects, both magical and mundane, are nullified by the sphere. Magma within the sphere will instantly harden, though it may re-melt depending on conditions after leaving the effects of the sphere.
Causes a large area of soft earth to become waterlogged. Beings passing through the affected area suffer a penalty (-2 mile per hour/-2' per sec.) to their movement rates.

Provides 2 magical layers of physical armor, considered flexible (layer 1) and semi-flexible(layer 2), with a combined armor rating of 2 per Piety Control. This magical armor will appear below any clothing or armor already worn (layers 1 and 2), and weighs 2 pounds per Piety Control. All armor layering rules still apply. If the armor created by this invocation is removed, it disappears and the invocation is dispelled.

Encases the target in a thin layer of illusionary transparent, swirling colors. For every 4 Piety Control of the invoker, the affected being or object takes 1 less die of damage from all aura energy-based attacks.

Creates an invisible sphere of protection of climate protection around the invoker that moves with the invoker. All weather effects, wind, precipitation, temperature changes, etc., within the sphere are removed. Wind is altered to no more than 40 mph if desired for sail travel, or removed as desired. Temperature changes to 72 degrees in the area affected. Magma within the sphere will instantly harden, though it may re-melt depending on conditions after leaving the effects of the sphere.

Creates one weapon of the invoker's choice imbued with the power of frost. The weapon appears as a shimmering, icy version of that weapon type. It is considered a magic weapon; for each 5 Piety Control of the invoker, it has +1 to hit, +1 to damage, and inflicts an additional 1d4 magical frost damage. The weapon is a physical object that causes damage like an ordinary weapon, but a Magic Resistance is allowed to avoid the frost damage.

Creates one weapon of the invoker's choice imbued with the power of fire. The weapon appears as a shimmering, flaming version of that weapon type. It is considered a magic weapon; for each 5 Piety Control of the invoker, it has +1 to hit, +1 to damage, and inflicts an additional 1d6 magical fire damage. The weapon is a physical object that causes damage like an ordinary weapon, but a Magic Resistance is allowed to avoid the fire damage.
Encases the target in a dark magical glow. For every 4 Piety Control of the invoker, the affected being or object takes 1 less die of damage from all negative energy or death energy-based attacks.

Provides 3 magical layers of physical armor, considered flexible (layer 1), semi-flexible(layer 2), and rigid (layer 3), with a combined armor rating of 3 per Piety Control. This magical armor will appear below any clothing already worn (layers 1, 2, and 3), and weighs 3 pounds per Piety Control. All armor layering rules still apply. If the armor created by this invocation is removed, it disappears and the invocation is dispelled.

Creates one weapon of the invoker's choice imbued with the power of electricty. The weapon appears as a shimmering, arcing version of that weapon type. It is considered a magic weapon; for each 5 Piety Control of the invoker, it has +1 to hit, +1 to damage, and inflicts an additional 1d8 magical electrical damage. The weapon is a physical object that causes damage like an ordinary weapon, but a Magic Resistance is allowed to avoid the electrical damage.

Causes 1 object made of animal skin or fur to transform into the largest possible animal of that type under the mental control of the invoker for the duration of the invocation. If the animal is killed, or the invocation expires the animal skin object reverts to normal and is undamaged. At 20 PC the animal summoned can be of magical type if the skin is also of that type of magical animal. The invoker has the ability to project into the transformed animal as if having used Animal Projection.

Creates one weapon of the invoker's choice dripping with the chemical power of acid. The weapon appears as a version of that weapon type smothered in dripping acid just above the grip. It is considered a magic weapon; for each 5 Piety Control of the invoker, it has +1 to hit, +1 to damage, and inflicts an additional 1d10 magical acid damage. The weapon is a physical object that causes damage like an ordinary weapon, but a Magic Resistance is allowed to avoid the acid damage.

Provides 3 magical layers of physical armor, considered flexible (layer 1), semi-flexible(layer 2), and rigid (layer 3), with a combined armor rating of 3 per Piety Control and an 1 additional point of Spiritual Armor per Piety Control. This magical armor will appear below any clothing already worn (layers 1, 2, and 3), and weighs 3 pounds per Piety Control. All armor layering rules still apply. If the armor created by this invocation is removed, it disappears and the invocation is dispelled.

Creates one weapon of the invoker's choice surrounded by a scintillating field of magic, filled with the power of chaos. The weapon appears as a version of that weapon type with a shifting multi-color field of chaos just above the grip. It is considered a magic weapon; for each 5 Piety Control of the invoker, it has +1 to hit, +1 to damage, and inflicts an additional 1d12 magical aura damage. The weapon is a physical object that causes damage like an ordinary weapon, but a Magic Resistance is allowed to avoid the aura damage.

The area affected becomes superheated and molten, and fire erupts from its surface. Any beings within the area of effect begin sinking into the ground and may catch fire as well. Any body area coming into contact with the molten earth receives 10d6 points of damage in the form of blisters and burns. At the end of the duration, the molten earth quickly cools to its normal temperature, trapping all affected beings. Submerged beings will begin to asphyxiate. May be cast on any natural surface.

Creates one weapon of the invoker's choice surrounded by a murky black field of negative energy. The weapon appears as a version of that weapon type with a murky black field of negative energy just above the grip. It is considered a magic weapon; for each 5 Piety Control of the invoker, it has +1 to hit, +1 to damage, and inflicts an additional 1d20 magical death damage. The weapon is a physical object that causes damage like an ordinary weapon, but a Magic Resistance is allowed to avoid the death damage. If placed against an undead being (or any other being of negative life force) for a full 10 seconds, the normal damage (1d20 per 5 PC) becomes a healing effect instead, healing the damage rolled to the area touched. The weapon can also emanate darkness, creating a sphere of up to a 2 foot radius per PC around the invoker if the invoker concentrates for 5 seconds. Living beings with vision in the darkness sphere are considered to be blinded unless making a Magic Resistance. The invoker is immune to the effects of the darkness sphere.

Creates one weapon of the invoker's choice surrounded by a radiant of positive energy. The weapon appears as a version of that weapon type with a radiant field of positive energy just above the grip. It is considered a magic weapon; for each 5 Piety Control of the invoker, it has +1 to hit, +1 to damage, and inflicts an additional 1d20 magical life damage (against undead or negative energy beings). The weapon is a physical object that causes damage like an ordinary weapon, but a Magic Resistance is allowed to avoid the life damage. If placed against a living (or any other being of positive life force) for a full 10 seconds, the normal damage (1d20 per 5 PC) becomes a healing effect instead, healing the damage rolled to the area touched. The weapon can also emanate light, creating a brilliant sphere of light up to a 2 foot radius per PC around the invoker if the invoker concentrates for 5 seconds. Undead and negative life force beings with vision in the brilliant sphere are considered to be blinded unless making a Magic Resistance. The invoker is immune to the effects of the brilliant sphere.
Locks the target onto its current plane. Any attempt to plane walk, phase, etc. by the target being immediately fails -- no contest is created, failure is automatic unlike Planar Hold.

The user concentrates for 5 seconds and then makes physical contact with another living being or creature.
