If the being has any form of lost Endurance (damage) then the invoker is required to make a Will Force to maintain contact as the pain of those wounds is felt by the invoker. If the Will Force save is made, then the invoker maintains contact for an additional 5 seconds. At the end of this period the invoker will have a catalog of wounds sustained by the being contacted. At higher than 10 PC the exact nature of the wounds will be understood, broken bones, loss of function, etc. Below 10 PC only the general level of the wounds will be understood. Thus, a chest wound of 12 points will be rated as more severe than a small 2 point cut on the hand. Only the damage itself will be known but not the source of the damage. Thus, poison, disease, or ongoing magical effects will not reveal themselves to the invoker.

The target being's voice is amplified several fold. All beings within 100' per Piety Control can clearly hear the speaker, even above the din of battle. The tone of voice is not changed, but the volume remains very loud, even if the speaker is whispering. The skills Battle Cry and Intimidation are increased by 20% when the speaker is affected by Thunderous Voice.

The target being's voice can be clearly heard by all beings within 100' per PC as if the speaker were right next to them. The carried voice still reflects the tone and quality of the speaker's voice, but the volume remains constant whether the speaker is whispering or yelling. The skills Battle Cry, and Intimidation are increased by 20% when the speaker is affected by Carry Voice. Any magical or divine magical songs, poems, ballads, or hymns have their area of effect (but not number affected) increased up to the range of this invocation.
The invoker gains a greater sense of self, and this increases their Control Resistance by 10% for the duration.

Target beings gain the ability to comprehend all spoken and written words as if the words were in their own language. The target cannot speak or write in unknown languages. The utility lies in the long duration and the multiple targets.

Target being or creature must make a Control Resistance or go berserk as the Skill Berserking after 1d6+1 sec. Sapient beings or creatures are allowed a Control Resistance to break free (if desired) every 10 seconds.

The invoker focuses on a single container and then calls for the invocation, filling it with blessed drink of up to 6 oz. per PC. The blessed drink when consumed can have the following effects: 1) Can be alcoholic and of a type like beer, wine, brandy, whiskey, etc. 2) The strength of the alcohol can be no more than 3 proof per PC. The type of alcohol produced must be within the invoker's proof range. Beer is 2 to 9 proof for instance. 3) Removes 1 level of fatigue. 4) Removed 1 point of damage per 4 ounces consumed to all wounds. 5) +10% bonus to Poison and Disease Resistance. Duration is 1 hour per 4 ounces consumed. 6) +10% to Control Resistance and fear from an evil being. Duration is 1 hour per 4 ounces consumed. Damages as holy water but only against undead. Each of these properties is separate and may not be provided by a particular deity. For instance, if the deity frowns on drink then the blessed drink will not be alcoholic.

The invoker focuses on a single container and then calls for the invocation, filling it with corrupted drink of up to 6 oz. per PC. The corrupted drink when consumed can have the following effects: 1) Can be alcoholic and of a type like beer, wine, brandy, whiskey, etc. 2) The strength of the alcohol can be no more than 3 proof per PC. The type of alcohol produced must be within the invoker's proof range. Beer is 2 to 9 proof for instance. 3) Causes 1 level of fatigue. 4) Causes 1 point of damage per 4 ounces consumed to all wounds. 5) -10% bonus to Poison and Disease Resistance. Duration is 1 hour per 4 ounces consumed. 6) -10% to Control Resistance and fear from an evil being. Duration is 1 hour per 4 ounces consumed. Heals as unholy water but only against undead. Each of these properties is separate and may not be provided by a particular deity. For instance, if the deity frowns on drink then the blessed drink will not be alcoholic.

The invoker takes any non-magical, non-divine object they can hold in their hand and touches it to one being. Then one fate is named per PC of the invoker, and an action for the token is described if that fate should happen to befall the target. The fates may include things like, control, death, wounding, banishment, immobile, etc. Then a condition of the token is named for each fate, such as tarnish appearing on a silver disk, spinning of a top, blood appearing on a knife, or beads sticking on a string, etc. These conditions occur on the token when and if the fate happens to the individual. The fate token does not have to be on either the invoker or the being, and it can be anywhere in the same multiverse so long as neither the token nor the being is in an anti-divinity area, or surrounded by some form of divine blockage. A being can never be the target of more than one fate token, and no more than 1 fate token per 5 PC can be in existence from this invoker at one time. When reaching 20 PC the fate token remains in existence a year and a day instead of the normal duration.

The invoker targets a being or creature and then concentrates for 1 minute. The target then makes a successful Magic Resistance or is sapped of energy and sustenance as if they had not eaten in the last 1 day per 2 Piety Control. Repeated castings add additional days of hunger until they begun to suffer the effects of starvation, which can eventually lead to death.

The invoker targets a being or creature and then concentrates for 1 minute. The being is then infused with life-giving water. For the next 1 hour per PC the invoker has no need for additional water regardless of the environment they are in, desert, arctic, etc. If the PC of the invoker is 20 this becomes 1 full day.

Causes the sleeping target to make a successful Magic Resistance or have fitful sleep and dreams filled with dark and despairing dream images. Target makes a Wisdom save upon awakening. If the save fails then the target did not get any rest, healing, or removal of fatigue from sleeping (typically 1d4+1 levels of fatigue depending on previous day activity). If the save is successful, then healing can be no more than 1 point and only 1 fatigue level is restored.

The invoker targets a being or creature and then concentrates for 1 minute. The being is then filled with sustaining energy. Additionally for the next 1 hour per PC the invoker has no need for additional food. If the PC of the invoker is 20 this becomes 1 full day.

The invoker targets a being or creature and then concentrates for 1 minute. The target then makes a successful Magic Resistance or is dried out with water removed from their body as if they had not drunk any liquid in the last day. Repeated castings add additional days of thirst until they begun to suffer the effects of thirst, which can eventually lead to death.

By means of this invocation the invoker can adhere one physical object to the next shadow-shifted being or object it touches. The object will be adhered at 10 pounds per PC. This means that for every PC of the invoker, 10 pounds of pressure must be applied to pull the object free from whatever it has been adhered to, otherwise, it remains stuck. A character may exert up to their load limit to pull themselves or the adhered object free. A successful Force skill roll will also work. This invocation allows a shadow-shifted being to carry a non-shadow shifted object. The target of the invocation cannot be an object on the Shadow Plane, unless the invoker is on the Shadow Plane. If the adhered object touches flesh, the being gets a Magic Resistance to avoid the object sticking. If it sticks, the outer layer of skin will drop off 8-12 hours later, freeing the adhered creature. Characters attempting to pull free may do so if they possess enough strength but will take 2d6 damage to adhered areas. Allows a shadow shifted invoker to adhere a shadow shifted object to non-shadow shifted object or being. While shadow shifted a non-shadow shifted object cannot be the target of this invocation.

Causes damage from the target to be equalized between the invoker and the target. Each takes half of the damage to the areas wounded. If the bodies of the invoker and the target do not match then in areas that do not match the damage is applied to a random body area of the invoker. If the target is effected by poison or disease then the target gets a new resistance at +20% to remove the poison/and or disease. However, the invoker must also make a Poison or Disease Resistance for each effect at +20% or likewise become affected.

By means of this invocation the invoker can adhere one physical object to the next phased being or object it touches. The object will be adhered at 10 pounds per PC. This means that for every PC of the invoker, 10 pounds of pressure must be applied to pull the object free from whatever it has been adhered to, otherwise, it remains stuck. A character may exert up to their load limit to pull themselves or the adhered object free. A successful Force skill roll will also work. This invocation allows a phased being to carry a non-phased object. The target of the invocation cannot be an object on the Phase Plane, unless the invoker is on the Phase Plane. If the adhered object touches flesh, the being gets a Magic Resistance to avoid the object sticking. If it sticks, the outer layer of skin will drop off 8-12 hours later, freeing the adhered creature. Characters attempting to pull free may do so if they possess enough strength but will take 2d6 damage to adhered areas. Allows a shadow shifted invoker to adhere a phased object to non-phased object or being. While phased a non-phased object cannot be the target of this invocation.
Target is considered immobile (can still use arms and legs but cannot move) with a strong force constricting the neck. Asphyxiation begins per asphyxiation rules.

The target being or creature has sight restored to them even if the loss of vision was natural, disease, poison, magical, or divine magical in nature. This invocation even physically regenerates the eyes or the part of the brain that sees if that was damaged. The only type of blindness this does not remove is that caused due to some forms of insanity.

Prevents the target from falling asleep normally, and grants immunity to magical or divine magical sleep effects. However, this is a mixed blessing as it also prevents an individual from sleeping to regain health, lost fatigue, or benefit earned experience.

Causes one humanoid per 2 Piety Control to obey the mental commands of the invoker. Affected beings will not do anything that will put them in danger they are aware of or go against their alignment. Asking them to do so grants a new Control Resistance and they will not obey the request even if they fail the Control Resistance.

Grants the invoker the ability to touch one small material statue or figurine (above 3“ and below 3' in average dimensions) while thinking or speaking a message. When the message is finished, the statue comes alive and then attempts to deliver the message to the recipient anywhere on the same plane. The location or the recipient must be described in detail. If a true name is known, then the stone messenger does not need any instructions to seek the recipient. The characteristics of the material messenger depend partially on the material it was created with as noted below with general characteristics at the end. CLAY/HARDENED EARTH: STR 10, AGL 10, VIT 10, END 10+1 per PC, Hide 5. WOOD: STR 11, AGL 11, VIT 11, END 15+1 per PC, Hide 8. STONE: STR 12, AGL 12, VIT 12, END 20+2 per PC, Hide 12. CRYSTAL: STR 13, AGL 13, VIT 13, END 25+2 per PC, Hide 15. METAL: STR 14, AGL 14, VIT 14, END 25+3 per PC, Hide 20. GENERAL: INT 10, WIS 10, KNW 10. Immune to Fatigue. Avoids confrontation, has no offensive ability. Magical voice, sight, and hearing. It does not speak except to deliver the message to the recipient, but it can listen and see, aiding it in delivering the message. It has locomotion equal to the type of object it was. If it was an animal or small humanoid then it moves as that animal or humanoid, flying if winged, running if not, etc. If the object is something else then apply the appropriate locomotion; a boat will sail (or row), a balloon will float, a wagon or a ball will roll, etc. It must have some kind of applicable locomotion, however. For example: attempting to use a stone cube as a stone messenger simply fails. When the message is delivered, or the duration ends, the messenger reverts to its original form wherever it was. It attempts to be upright when this happens if this is possible. If the messenger takes damage and then returns to statue form, one half of the damage is still present. Multiple invocations will reduce damage by half each time it is used on the same damaged statue or figurine. When it finally reaches 1 damage in an area, the next invocation will remove the last point of damage.

Allows the invoker to touch one statue or carving that then animates and becomes a porter for the invoker. The stature or carving affected can be no larger than 7' in any one dimension. The characteristics of the material porter depend partially on the material it was created with as noted below with general characteristics at the end. CLAY/HARDENED EARTH: STR 12, AGL 12, VIT 12, END 10+1 per PC, Hide 5, Carry 100 lb. WOOD: STR 13, AGL 13, VIT 13, END 15+1 per PC, Hide 8, Carry 150 lb. STONE: STR 14, AGL 14, VIT 14, END 20+2 per PC, Hide 12, Carry 200 lb. CRYSTAL: STR 15, AGL 15, VIT 15, END 25+2 per PC, Hide 15, Carry 250 lb. METAL: STR 16, AGL 16, VIT 16, END 25+3 per PC, Hide 20, Carry 300 lb. GENERAL: INT 12, WIS 12, KNW 12. Immune to Fatigue. Avoids confrontation, has no offensive ability. It has a magical sense of touch, sight, and hearing. It understands the invoker's spoken commands in any language the invoker speaks. It moves at up to 30' per second or 20 miles per hour. When the duration ends, the porter reverts to its original form wherever it was. It attempts to be upright when this happens if this is possible. If the porter takes damage and then returns to statue form, one half of the damage is still present. Multiple invocations will reduce damage by half each time it is used on the same damaged statue or figurine. When it finally reaches 1 damage in an area, the next invocation will remove the last point of damage.
Causes one being to make a successful Magic Resistance or have invisible planar shackles on their spirit, keeping them from entering or leaving the Phase Plane for the duration.
Causes one being to make a successful Magic Resistance or have invisible planar shackles on their spirit, keeping them from entering or leaving the Shadow Plane for the duration.

Allows the invoker to share and possibly ease the mental suffering of one target. For every mental effect like control, insanity, confusion, etc., the target is afforded a new resistance or save at +20%. If the target makes the save or resistance, then the effect is removed. However, the invoker must also make a save or resistance at +20% for each effect or be stricken by them. If the target is in mental combat, the touch of the invoker's mind interrupts and ends the mental combat no matter who began it.

Allows the invoker to touch one animal or being and then cause spirit shackles to appear on them if they fail a Magic Resistance. At up to 9 PC only the wrists are shackled, making physical combat effectively impossible. At 10 or better PC the ankles are shackled, reducing movement to 1/2 half normal walking speed. At 15 or higher PC the wrist and ankle shackles are pulled together and joined, and the target is completely hobbled, falling prone for the duration unless they possess more than two pair of limbs. At 20 PC all limbs are shackled together no matter how many there are.

The invoker narrows and weakens the connections and pathways to all planes in the area of effect for the duration. Any summoning or banishment effect becomes a contest against this spell at 5% per PC of the invoker against the spell or skill used to summon or banish. Existing open gateways to other planes are unaffected by this invocation.

The target being must make a Magic Resistance or be plagued by menacing, visions of the invoker even while awake. If the target sees the invoker and has a Will Force below 15, they must make a Control Resistance or flee in fear until out of sight. Will Force saves are required to maintain concentration within sight of the invoker, and to attack the invoker. If a save is made to attack the invoker, the affected being is +1 to hit and damage for any melee or missile attack.

Allows the invoker to touch one statue or carving of an animal that then animates and becomes a guardian for the invoker. The stature or carving affected can be no larger than 7' in any one dimension. The characteristics of the material animal guardian depend partially on the material it was created with, as noted below with general characteristics at the end. CLAY/HARDENED EARTH: STR 14, AGL 14, VIT 14, END 10+1 per PC, +2 Damage(Weight). WOOD: STR 15, AGL 15, VIT 15, END 15+1 per PC, Hide 8, +1 Damage(Weight). STONE: STR 16, AGL 16, VIT 16, END 20+2 per PC, Hide 12, +3 Damage(Weight). CRYSTAL: STR 17, AGL 17, VIT 17, END 25+2 per PC, Hide 15, +2 Damage(Weight). METAL: STR 18, AGL 18, VIT 18, END 25+3 per PC, Hide 20, +2 Damage(Weight). GENERAL: INT 12, WIS 12, KNW 12. Attacks as the animal type (but damage is 1d6 per 3 PC). Attack skill is 1 higher than the invoker. Follows the commands of the invoker. If the invoker is injured it ignores current commands to aid the invoker. Immune to Fatigue. It has a magical sense of touch, sight, and hearing. It understands the invoker's spoken commands in any language the invoker speaks. It moves at up to 30' per second or 20 miles per hour. When the duration ends, the animal guardian reverts to its original form wherever it was. It attempts to be upright when this happens if this is possible. If the animal guardian takes damage and then returns to statue form, one half of the damage is still present. Multiple invocations will reduce damage by half each time it is used on the same damaged statue or figurine. When it finally reaches 1 damage in an area, the next invocation will remove the last point of damage.

Allows the invoker to share and possibly ease the personal deformities of one target. For every large blemish, scar, damage to voice, even a bad reputation, that lowers Appearance, Charm, or Social Class the target is afforded a Magic Resistance at +20% even if the cause of the effect was not magic. If the resistance is made the condition is removed. However, the invoker must also now make a Magic Resistance at +20% for each effect or be stricken by them. This can have a profound effect as bad deeds that the target may be wanted for criminally may end up being shared, or entirely transferred to the invoker, meaning the invoker could suddenly be in trouble for deeds they didn't commit.

The invoker and all allies within range except a single chosen target take 1d4 per 5 PC to a random location. The damage done to the allies and the invoker is then applied as healing to the target. The target may not be the invoker.

One 5' section of 8 spiritual bars (1 half inch thick) will appear from floor to ceiling per 2 PC. For example, at 8 PC a 5' x 5' cage could be created. If the ceiling is more than 30' higher than the floor the spirit bars curve towards the middle and create a rounded top. The bars are indestructible but there is almost a half inch gap between each bar. If the bars are created on top of someone the displacement effect takes place and they will be 50% likely to be displaced out of the bars rather than inside.

Allows the invoker to convert their form into a swarm of vermin. The type of creatures is limited by invoker's Piety Control. The invoker converts into the swarm and then the swarm moves as the invoker wills. The invoker's mind, spirit, and soul are attached to the swarm as a whole. The physical attributes, characteristics, resistances (poison and disease), and movement changes to the creature swarm type. Any single part of the swarm that gets more than 1' away from the remainder of the swarm per PC vanishes after 10 seconds. The invoker is unable to voluntarily disperse the swarm without killing themselves. If a single creature of the swarm remains, so does the invoker. At the end of the invocation, or when the invoker returns to their true form, damage based on the loss of swarm creatures is recorded. This damage is spread evenly all body areas. The minimum damage is 1. Thus, if a single swarm creature is killed even if the percentage drops below 1 actual damage, 1 damage is assessed anyway. Returning to natural form takes 5 seconds as the swarm, or what remains of it tries to gather in the form of the being, even the remaining dead bodies are pulled into the being's form. The missing or dead swarm members become scabby wounds (sealed). Possible Forms: TINY CRAWLING INSECTS: 100 insects per invoker END. Each insect is 1/10th of 1 END. Crawl 1/10/1 or Jump 5/50/5. Every 10 insects killed = 1 END damage. No abilities. TINY FLYING INSECTS: 100 insects per invoker END. Each insect is 1/10th of 1 END. Fly 12/110/11 or Crawl 1/10/1 or Jump 5/50/5. Every 10 insects killed = 1 END damage. BITING FLYING INSECTS: 10 insects per invoker END. Each insect is 1 END. Fly 12/110/11 or Crawl 1/10/1 or Jump 5/50/5. Attack Bite: 2 sec. Piercing, 1 damage. Every insect killed = 1 END damage. DISEASE-BEARING FLYING INSECTS: 10 insects per invoker END. Each insect is 1 END. Fly 12/110/11 or Crawl 1/10/1 or Jump 5/50/5. Attack Bite: 2 sec. Piercing, 1 damage, causes DR or non-magical disease. Every insect killed = 1 END damage. VENOMOUS SPIDERS: 10 spiders per invoker END. Each spider is 1 END. Crawl 1/10/1 or Jump 5/50/5. Attack Bite: 2 sec. Piercing, 1 damage, causes PR or poison Type XII, potency M. Every spider killed = 1 END damage. RATS: 1 rat per invoker END. Each rat is 2 END. Slink 2/20/2, Crawl 4/40/4, Scurry 6/60/6. Attacks-Bite: 2 sec. Piercing, 1d4 damage, Claw 2 sec. Cutting, 1 damage. Every rat killed = 5 END damage. DISEASE-BEARING RATS: 1 rat per invoker END. Each rat is 2 END. Slink 2/20/2, Crawl 4/40/4, Scurry 6/60/6. Attacks-Bite: 2 sec. Cutting, 1d4 damage causes DR or non-magical disease, Claw 2 sec. Piercing, 1 damage. Every rat killed = 5 END damage. BATS: 1 bat per 2 invoker END. Each bat is 2 END. Slink 2/20/2, Fly 15/150/15. Attacks-Bite: 4 sec. Cutting, 1-2 damage, Claw 3 sec. Cutting, 1 damage. Every bat killed = 10 END damage. DISEASE-BEARING BATS: 1 bat per 2 invoker END. Each bat is 2 END. Slink 2/20/2, Fly 15/150/15. Attacks-Bite: 4 sec. Cutting, 1-2 damage causes DR or non-magical disease, Claw 3 sec. Cutting, 1 damage. Every bat killed = 10 END damage. SNAKES: 1 snake per invoker END. Each snake is 2 END. Slither at 6/60/6 or Swim at 2/20/2. Attacks-Bite: 4 sec. Piercing, 1-2 damage. Every snake killed = 8 END damage. VENOMOUS SNAKES: 1 snake per 3 invoker END. Each snake is 2 END. Slither at 6/60/6 or Swim at 2/20/2. Attacks-Bite: 4 sec. Piercing, 1-2 damage, causes PR or poison Type XV, potency M. Every snake killed = 15 END damage.

Allows the invoker to pick any two targets and transfer body area health between them, damaging the focus for 1d4+1 per 2 PC, and then adding whatever amount was done as healing to the body area on the beneficiary. Both the focus and the beneficiary must be within 5' per PC. The invoker cannot transfer more health than the body area has, so if the damage goes over the total amount of endurance in the area then only that is transferred. The amount of Endurance between 0 and negative Vitality cannot be damaged by this spell, nor transferred. No single area may be retargeted as the focus by additional castings of this invocation even if there are other casters, until it is completely healed.

Allows the invoker to share and possibly ease the sorrows of the soul of one target. For every effect which aged, withered, or stole life from them as well as any that drained or altered Aura, Piety, or Will Force involuntarily they are afforded a new Magic or Control Resistance at +20%, whether one was afforded for the initial effect or not. Any resistances made remove the effect. The invoker must also make a Magic or Control Resistance at +20% for each effect or suffer it themselves.

Allows the invoker to touch one statue or carving of a humanoid that then animates and becomes a defender for the invoker. The stature or carving affected can be no larger than 9' in any one dimension. The characteristics of the material warrior defender depend partially on the material it was created with, as noted below with general characteristics at the end. CLAY/HARDENED EARTH: STR 16, AGL 16, VIT 16, END 15+1 per PC, +3 Damage(Weight). WOOD: STR 17, AGL 17, VIT 17, END 20+1 per PC, Hide 8, +2 Damage(Weight). STONE: STR 18, AGL 18, VIT 18, END 25+2 per PC, Hide 12, +4 Damage(Weight). CRYSTAL: STR 19, AGL 19, VIT 19, END 30+2 per PC, Hide 15, +3 Damage(Weight). METAL: STR 20, AGL 20, VIT 20, END 30+3 per PC, Hide 20, +5 Damage(Weight). GENERAL: INT 15, WIS 15, KNW 15. The warrior is ambidextrous. Can use any weapon or it's hands doing 1d6+2 per 3 Piety Control every 2 seconds. Attack skill is 2 higher than the invoker. Follows the commands of the invoker.Immune to Fatigue. It has a magical sense of touch, sight, hearing, and life sensing. It understands the invoker's spoken commands in any language the invoker speaks. It moves at up to 30' per second or 20 miles per hour. When the duration ends, the material defender reverts to its original form wherever it was. It attempts to be upright when this happens if this is possible. If the material defender takes damage and then returns to statue form, one half of the damage is still present. Multiple invocations will reduce damage by half each time it is used on the same damaged statue or figurine. When it finally reaches 1 damage in an area, the next invocation will remove the last point of damage.

The caster narrows and weakens the connections and pathways to all planes in the area of effect for the duration. Any summoning or banishment effect becomes impossible in the area affected. Existing open gateways to other planes are unaffected by this invocation.

This invocation permanently removes the effects of insanity, control, fear, confusion, and any effects which caused or causes mind changes in one other being. The invoker cannot target themselves with this invocation. Permanent effects require 1/10th of 1 Will Force to be spent by either the target or the invoker. The decision can be made at the end of the invocation when mental health is restored, and this makes the effect permanent, otherwise any permanent mental disabilities or changes returns in 1 hour per Will Force of the target.

The target must make a successful Magic Resistance or have Intelligence, Wisdom, and Knowledge lowered to 10 for the duration of the invocation. At the end of the duration all mental attributes return to their previous ratings. If the target being already had any mental attribute lower than 10, that attribute is not raised by this effect. Resistances, skills, saves, and all modifiers from Intelligence, Wisdom, or Knowledge are lowered for the duration.
Up to 1 ally per 3 PC in range receives 1d4 healing to all wounded areas per 5 PC. The invoker is not themselves a target of the invocation.

Uses a likeness of a being to summon their spirit back from the dead even if it has moved on. The chance of doing this varies by the source of the likeness see below. The spirit while not required to respond, may decide to communicate. They do so by inhabiting the likeness. The likeness can hear, see, talk, and life sense through the likeness but cannot move it. These magical abilities are superimposed on it. Ghosts released by ritual of Release Dead or through the skill Call of the Light will not be drawn to the likeness, only those that have naturally moved on or remained as ghosts. Chance of success is based on the likeness: Inscription 10%, Sketch 20%, Tapestry 30%, Painting 40%, Carving 50%, Bas Relief 60%, Sculpture 75%.

By means of this invocation the target being and all the possessions being carried become shadowy, and then enter the Shadow Plane. The being appears as a shadowy, faded version of themselves. All physical actions against the caster will have no effect whatsoever, but the reverse also holds true. Entering an Anti-Magic zone will cause the being to return from the Shadow Plane. Should the character drop an object, it will remain shadow shifted and can only be retrieved by another shadow shifted being. Alternately, the spell can simply be cast on an object causing it to shadow shifted out until retrieved by another shadow shifted being. All mental powers held by the caster or enemies thereof will freely pass onto the Shadow Plane, so that mental combat is possible. If a living being is killed on the Shadow Plane, its body will stay shadow shifted and may become a ghost trapped forever between dimensions. However, if the being is merely unconscious, they will return at the end of the invocation's duration.

Allows a being to see as if it were day. If used during at night the moon will still be visible in the sky (if applicable), but to the affected being it will be very difficult to see. The sky appears filled with the brightness of daylight, and the land appears exactly as if it were day. Beings with night-sensitive vision, as well as those with an appropriate magically or divinely enhanced vision, may treat their vision as though it were actually day. This does not actually make it day; the affected being simply perceives the world as though it were.

Allows a being to see as if it were night. If used during at day the sun will still be visible in the sky (if applicable), but appear to be muted and dim. Stars become visible as if the sun were not present, and the land appears blanketed in darkness exactly as if it were night. Beings with day-sensitive vision, as well as those with an appropriate magically or divinely enhanced vision, may treat their vision as though it were actually night. This does not actually make it night; the affected being simply perceives the world as though it were.

Allows the caster to create 1 hand of light per 2 PC within the range noted. Each is created separately and may be attached where desired as long as they are within range and not on an unwilling being. This can be placed on a person or their clothes as long as they are a willing target. Each hand has the following properties: 3 Endurance per PC. 1 point of spiritual armor per PC. Strong illumination within a 2-foot radius per PC. Dim illumination within a 5-foot radius per PC. Hand includes a wrist, four fingers and a thumb. Opens, grasps and holds by the invoker's thought for the duration and can hold up to 2 lb. per PC of the invoker. If more is attempted to be held or grasped the hand falls off what it is attached to and vanishes. Is not strong or agile enough to wield weapons or grasp an unwilling living being.

Allows the caster to create 1 tendril of darkness per 2 PC within the range noted. Each is created separately and may be attached where desired as long as they are within range and not on an unwilling being. This can be placed on a person or their clothes as long as they are a willing target. Each tendril has the following properties: 3 Endurance per PC. 1 point of spiritual armor per PC. Creates a darkness field of 1-foot radius per PC. Creates shadowy field of 3-foot radius per PC. Tendril includes a short length of 6 inches and then splits into four flexible, tendril fingers 4 inches in length. Opens, grasps and holds by the invoker's thought for the duration and can hold up to 2 lb. per PC of the invoker. If more is attempted to be held or grasped the tendril falls off what it is attached to and vanishes. Is not strong or agile enough to wield weapons or grasp an unwilling living being.

Wraps the invoker in divine clothing, appears under or over other clothing so long as the symbols are not obscured. The form of the clothing is chosen by the invoker and may be as simple as a shawl or as complex as a suit of enhanced leather armor.  The bonus to PC granted by the raiment does not allow the invoker the ability to pray for invocations at a higher PC it just allows the effects of the invocations they have to be improved. This higher PC also has no effect on the raiment invocation itself and does not extend the raiment's duration or effects. The clothing has the following properties: 1) The raiment is considered a holy symbol and has their symbol displayed prominently. 2) It is always clean and repairs itself the moment it is damaged. 3) Per 4 PC the raiment grants a +1 modifier to the invoker's PC itself, allowing other invocation effects to be at a higher PC. 4) It can be made of leather or any flexible material but may not protect more than 1 armor value per 2 PC. 5) If the invoker is good then the raiment glows when the invoker desires acting as a diffuse source of light for up to 2' per PC. 6) If the invoker is evil then the raiment dims the light around them acting as near darkness (-4 to hit) for up to 2' per PC. This effect has no impact on the invoker's own vision. 7) At 10 or higher PC the raiment grants a +2% to commune, and +5% to omen and divination. 8) At 15 or higher PC it grants the following benefits by alignment; good: +5% to turn undead and banish, neutral: +5% to summon animal and totem call, evil: +5% to control undead and banish. 9) If the raiment is removed for any reason, it vanishes 1 minute after leaving the invoker's touch. 10) At 20 PC the raiment can now be worn completely under other armor or clothing even obscuring the symbols because those symbols are now projected by the raiment through any substance even magical, appearing as symbols etched in light for good, outlines of shadow and darkness for evil, and a primary color of the invoker's (or deity's) choice for neutral.

Allows the invoker to create a pair of wings attached anywhere they desire, head, feet, shoulders, etc. Thereafter, they can float off the ground at no higher than 5 feet. They can also move in a desired direction based on PC. If under 10 PC they move at their jogging speed. At 10 or higher PC they move at running speed. Generally, the wings have a look that matches their major alignment type: Good (white angelic wings), Evil (bat-like impish wings), Neutral (insect wings). However, if they have a special nature such as a higher planar connection because they are incarnate then the wings may match the incarnate type instead: Celestial (white angelic wings), Infernal (bat-like impish wings), Daeva (insect wings). Invokers of 15 or higher Will Force can force the wings to appear in whatever form they wish.

Grants the invoker bodily protection. This effect absorbs up to 2 damage per PC before failing. Whenever the invoker's body would otherwise be damaged, for any instant reason the damage is first applied to the buffer, reducing it by the damaged amount instead of applying that damage to the invoker.  If there is any remaining buffer then it continues to protect the invoker until either the buffer is used up or the duration expires. If at any time the buffer is not enough to stop all of the damage then the remainder of the damage is applied as normal, and is merely reduced by the amount of the remaining buffer and the duration ends. Also keeps physical attributes from being drained involuntarily. Also stops undead transformation effects that would convert the being into a physical only form of undead like a zombie or skeleton. Duration effect damages such as drowning, poison, bleeding from an existing wound, damage to skin or eyes from light, etc. are not covered by this invocation. For example, being dipped in acid or lit on fire would not be covered as these damage types are applied slowly over duration but being hit by the spells finger of acid or fire would be affected by this invocation as they are an instant effect when cast.

Allows the caster to create 1 hand of binding light per 2 PC within the range noted. Each is created separately and may be attached where desired as long as they are within range and not on an unwilling being. This can be placed on a person or their clothes as long as they are a willing target. Each hand has the following properties: 3 Endurance per PC. 1 point of spiritual armor per PC. Strong illumination within a 2-foot radius per PC. Dim illumination within a 5-foot radius per PC. Hand includes a forearm, wrist, four fingers and a thumb. Strength and Agility of 15+1 per 4 full PC. Opens, grasps and holds by the invoker's thought for the duration and can hold up to 3 lb. per PC of the invoker. If more is attempted to be held or grasped the hand falls off what it is attached to and vanishes. Can sense evil within its grasping range (5 feet). Is not capable of wielding weapons but will attempt to grasp evil beings on its own or other targets by mental thought. Treat as standard grappling: 10 or better to hit (+ Agility to hit bonus) and then contests of the hand's Strength versus the grasped target's Agility. This is rolled every 5 seconds until either the hand wins twice (pinned) or the target wins and escapes.

Creates a light that extends outward from the invoker in a 2-feet radius per PC. Anyone in the light who takes hostile action must make a Control Resistance to do so. Even if the effected beings make this resistance and then attack another being the offending being makes a Magic Resistance or takes 1d4 divine damage per 4 PC of the invoker to the hand, foot or part of the body that directed the action. If the attack was mentally directed then the head is affected. These rolls are repeated for every hostile or aggressive action with no limits per round.

Creates a dimness that extends outward from the invoker in a 2-feet radius per PC. All who target the invoker must do so at a -4 penalty. Anyone in the dimness must make a Control Resistance once per round or take hostile action against the enemies of the invoker. If they make the resistance and they choose not to take hostile action then they must make a further Magic Resistance or suffer every 5 seconds or suffer 1d4 divine damage per 4 PC of the invoker to whatever foot, hand, body part they normally attack with. For example, a warrior carries a sword and so they takes 1d4 per PC to the hand holding the sword. A mage normally uses their mind to attack and so they take 1d4 per PC to the head.

Allows the caster to create 1 tendril of grasping darkness per 2 PC within the range noted. Each is created separately and may be attached where desired as long as they are within range and not on an unwilling being. This can be placed on a person or their clothes as long as they are a willing target. Each tendril has the following properties: 3 Endurance per PC. 1 point of spiritual armor per PC. Creates a darkness field of 1-foot radius per PC. Creates shadowy field of 3-foot radius per PC. Tendril includes a 2-foot large tentacle and then short length of 6 inches and then splits into four flexible, tendril fingers 4 inches in length. Opens, grasps and holds by the invoker's thought for the duration and can hold up to 3 lb. per PC of the invoker. If more is attempted to be held or grasped the tendril falls off what it is attached to and vanishes. Can sense good within its grasping range (5 feet). Is not capable of wielding weapons but will attempt to grasp good beings on its own or other targets by mental thought. Treat as standard grappling: 10 or better to hit (+ Agility to hit bonus) and then contests of the hand's Strength versus the grasped target's Agility. This is rolled every 5 seconds until either the hand wins twice (pinned) or the target wins and escapes.

Creates a transparent sphere lightly shaded a color that matches the deity's preference. All sound waves mundane or magical cannot pass through the sphere. Those within it can speak to each other. The sphere can be attached to a fixed location or a person, or object allowing it to move.

The invoker targets one being. That being is afforded a Control Resistance (if desired). If the Control Resistance fails then the invoker learns the most important single motivating factor driving the target being at that moment. It may be vague, or complicated and open to interpretation. Standard mental protections like Non-detection block this invocation, as do those of 15 or higher Will Force who wish to block intrusion and make a Will Force Save.

Grants the invoker personal spiritual protection. This invocation protects the being from any effect which would drain or temporarily reduce a personal attribute. Also guards the invoker from being converted into a lycanthrope or involuntary transformation of any kind. If the invoker is already a lycanthrope this can suppress or reverse the change.

The invoker casts this invocation either on a corpse they can see, or if none is visible, the nearest undead, spirit, ghost, or corpse becomes the target. If that being is animate (undead, not a corpse) then they are afforded a Control Resistance. If the resistance fails, or none was given because the target was a corpse (or a willing participant) then the invoker has full mental and sensory impressions of the last thoughts, feelings and experiences of the target up to the moment of death. The total length of those experiences is the last 1 minute per 2 PC of the invoker.

Creates a light that extends outward from the invoker in a 2-feet radius per PC. All allies in the light are granted a +5% to Resistances per 5 PC of the invoker. All allies are also -1 to be hit per 5 PC.

Creates a dimness that extends outward from the invoker in a 2-feet radius per PC. All who target the invoker must do so at a -4 penalty. All enemies in the shadow are forced to have a -5% to Resistances per 5 PC of the invoker. All enemies are also +1 to be hit per 5 PC.

Allows the caster to create 1 hand of defending light per 2 PC within the range noted. Each is created separately and may be attached where desired as long as they are within range and not on an unwilling being. This can be placed on a person or their clothes as long as they are a willing target. Each hand has the following properties: 3 Endurance per PC. 1 point of spiritual armor per PC. Strong illumination within a 2-foot radius per PC. Dim illumination within a 5-foot radius per PC. Hand includes an arm, forearm, wrist, four fingers and a thumb. Strength and Agility of 15+1 per 4 full PC. Opens, grasps and holds by the invoker's thought for the duration and can hold up to 4 lb. per PC of the invoker. If more is attempted to be held or grasped the hand falls off what it is attached to and vanishes. Can sense evil within its attacking range (10 feet). Is capable of wielding weapons and if desired a magical force-type weapon appears with the hand when it is created. The weapon can be any one-handed weapon that the invoker is also capable of wielding. This weapon is considered +1 per 4 PC of the invoker. If the weapon is dropped it disappears immediately. It will attempt to grasp or attack any evil beings within its sensing range. Other targets can be set by mental thought. If grappling, treat as standard grappling: 10 or better to hit (+ Agility to hit bonus) and then contests of the hand's Strength versus the grasped target's Agility. This is rolled every 5 seconds until either the hand wins twice (pinned) or the target wins and escapes.

Allows the caster to create 1 tendril of offending darkness per 2 PC within the range noted. Each is created separately and may be attached where desired as long as they are within range and not on an unwilling being. This can be placed on a person or their clothes as long as they are a willing target. Each tendril has the following properties: 3 Endurance per PC. 1 point of spiritual armor per PC. Creates a darkness field of 1-foot radius per PC. Creates shadowy field of 3-foot radius per PC. Tendril includes a 3-feet long tentacle section attached to a second 2-feet large tentacle and then a shorter tendril 6 inches long that then splits into four flexible, tendril fingers 4 inches in length. Opens, grasps and holds by the invoker's thought for the duration and can hold up to 4 lb. per PC of the invoker. If more is attempted to be held or grasped the tendril falls off what it is attached to and vanishes. Can sense good within its attacking range (10 feet). Is capable of wielding weapons at the attack skill of the invoker, and if desired a magical force-type weapon appears with the hand when it is created. The weapon can be any one-handed weapon that the invoker is also capable of wielding. This weapon is considered +1 per 4 PC of the invoker. If the weapon is dropped it disappears immediately. It will attempt to grasp or attack any good beings within its sensing range. Other targets can be set by mental thought. If grappling, treat as standard grappling: 10 or better to hit (+ Agility to hit bonus) and then contests of the hand's Strength versus the grasped target's Agility. This is rolled every 5 seconds until either the hand wins twice (pinned) or the target wins and escapes.

By means of this invocation one target being or the invoker themselves is given a new place of origin, bound to this plane and specific place when the invocation is completed. If the being was considered supernatural to the current plane, they are no longer supernatural on this plane. The being is allowed a Magic Resistance, to avoid being bound to this location, if desired. When the being is within 1000' feet of their bound origin, they have a sense of peace, of homeness. Being's that have not had this invocation cast on them still have an origin. Their origin is the place they were born. It is the place where the soul infused into them at birth.

Grants the invoker mental protection. While protected by this invocation they are immune to mental attack, and effects which result in control or insanity. If they were already insane or controlled then these effects are removed for the duration of the invocation. The invoker cannot themselves engage in mental combat or contact another being telepathically, nor can they be mentally contacted or probed by others while the invocation is in effect. Also keeps mental attributes from being drained involuntarily. Also stops any effect that would convert the being into a mental only form of undead like a poltergeist or horror.

Creates a light that extends outward from the invoker in a 2-feet radius per PC. All allies in the light are granted healing from a single healing pool. The total healing available is 10 per PC. Any ally in the light can heal their wounds once per 10 seconds up to the value in the healing pool. If the healing pool is exhausted the invocation ends immediately.

Sends up to 1 being per 2 PC within sight to their place of origin. Only beings that desire to return to their place of origin are affected, the effect is entirely optional. Everything they carry that is not another living being goes with them. Pets, tamed animal or controlled creatures go with them if they are touching them at the time of invocation's end. A being's place of origin is the place they were born. Unless they have had a Bind Origin invocation used on them to change that location.

Creates a dimness that extends outward from the invoker in a 2-feet radius per PC. All who target the invoker must do so at a -4 penalty. All enemies in the shadow are forced to make a Magic Resistance once per 10 seconds or take 1d4 per 4 PC to the being's or creature's head.

Guards the invoker's soul from harm. The invoker is now immune to the parts of effects which would involuntarily drain any mystical attribute. Protects the invoker from being converted into any undead that retains a soul.

Allows the caster to create 1 hand of blinding light per 2 PC within the range noted. Each is created separately and may be attached where desired as long as they are within range and not on an unwilling being. This can be placed on a person or their clothes as long as they are a willing target. Each hand has the following properties: 3 Endurance per PC. 1 point of spiritual armor per PC. Strong illumination within a 2-foot radius per PC. Dim illumination within a 5-foot radius per PC. Hand includes a shoulder, arm, forearm, wrist, four fingers and a thumb. Strength and Agility of 15+1 per 4 full PC. Opens, grasps and holds by the invoker's thought for the duration and can hold up to 5 lb. per PC of the invoker. If more is attempted to be held or grasped the hand falls off what it is attached to and vanishes. Can sense evil within its attacking range (10 feet). Is capable of wielding weapons and if desired a magical force-type weapon appears with the hand when it is created. The weapon can be any one-handed weapon that the invoker is also capable of wielding. This weapon is considered +1 per 4 PC of the invoker. If the weapon is dropped it disappears immediately. It will attempt to grasp or attack any evil beings within its sensing range. Other targets can be set by mental thought. If grappling, treat as standard grappling: 10 or better to hit (+ Agility to hit bonus) and then contests of the hand's Strength versus the grasped target's Agility. This is rolled every 5 seconds until either the hand wins twice (pinned) or the target wins and escapes. •	Any targets struck by the hand or a weapon wielded by the hand must make a Magic Resistance. Failure indicates the target becomes blind, deaf and mute for 1 minute per PC. If a being is grasped by the hand they must make this resistance once per 5 seconds. This effect does not include willing being's it is attached to (unless they are evil).

This invocation places the target being or animal into sleep until they are fully healed. If cast within one hour of death per Will Force it will even restore life, albeit slowly. Time to heal varies by the problem. Any ongoing damage is halted immediately upon entering the sleep. Doesn't work for decapitations, acid, brain or heart destroyed, etc. Target regenerates while sleeping at a rate of 1 Endurance per 4 PC per hour of sleep to all wounded areas, limbs will regrow, etc. Recovery from death drains a Will Force from the being permanently and takes 30 days - 1 day per Will Force of the focused being to recover. If the invocation expires before this time is complete then the being wakes up for 1d6 minutes and then dies again. Recovery from insanity and control takes 20 days -1 day per Will Force. Disease, poison effects, scarring, etc. are all healed at the end of the first day. All healing takes a minimum of 1 day to occur regardless of the Will Force of the target. The person asleep is asleep so deeply and so still that it takes life sense or Physiology social skill or like effect to tell they are alive. When completely healed a Will Force save is required for the focus to awaken. They are afforded one of these each morning until they awaken or the duration expires.

Creates a light that extends outward from the invoker 2-feet radius per PC of the invoker. All allies are -1 to be hit, +1 to hit and +1 damage per 5 PC. In addition allies are immune to fear and are granted a +5% to Control Resistance rolls per 5 PC of the invoker. Ally morale rolls are made at +25%.

Creates a dimness that extends outward from the invoker 2-feet radius per PC. All who target the invoker must do so at a -4 penalty. All enemies are +1 to be hit, -1 to hit and -1 damage per 5 PC. In addition enemies must make a Control Resistance or be affected by fear when first entering, or reentering the shadow. Enemies are have a -5% modifier to Control Resistance rolls per 5 PC of the invoker. Enemy morale saves are made at -25%.

Allows the caster to create 1 tendril of suffocating darkness per 2 PC within the range noted. Each is created separately and may be attached where desired as long as they are within range and not on an unwilling being. This can be placed on a person or their clothes as long as they are a willing target. Each tendril has the following properties: 3 Endurance per PC. 1 point of spiritual armor per PC. Creates a darkness field of 1-foot radius per PC. Creates shadowy field of 3-foot radius per PC. Tendril includes a 1 & 1/2 foot spherical, orb shoulder joint, attached to a 3-feet long tentacle section, attached to a second 2-feet large tentacle & then a shorter tendril 6 inches long that then splits into four flexible, tendril fingers 4 inches in length. Opens, grasps and holds by the invoker's thought for the duration and can hold up to 5 lb. per PC of the invoker. If more is attempted to be held or grasped the tendril falls off what it is attached to and vanishes. Can sense good within its attacking range (10 feet). Is capable of wielding weapons at the attack skill of the invoker, and if desired a magical force-type weapon appears with the hand when it is created. The weapon can be any one-handed weapon that the invoker is also capable of wielding. This weapon is considered +1 per 4 PC of the invoker. If the weapon is dropped it disappears immediately. It will attempt to grasp or attack any good beings within its sensing range. Other targets can be set by mental thought. If grappling, treat as standard grappling: 10 or better to hit (+ Agility to hit bonus) and then contests of the hand's Strength versus the grasped target's Agility. This is rolled every 5 seconds until either the hand wins twice (pinned) or the target wins and escapes. Any targets struck by the hand or a weapon wielded by the hand must make a Magic Resistance. Failure indicates the target becomes blind, deaf and mute for 1 minute per PC. If a being is grasped by the hand they must make this resistance once per 5 seconds. This effect does not include willing being's it is attached to (unless they are good).

Causes the invoker's hands to be charged with a hot, light energy. The first evil being or undead touched must make a Magic Resistance or take 2d4 heat damage per 4 Piety Control, and a second Magic Resistance or be paralyzed for 10 seconds per 4 Piety Control of the invoker. Undead targets must also make a Control Resistance or temporarily lose 1d4 Will Force per 6 Piety Control of the invoker.

Instantly restores any lost personal attribute points that were given up involuntarily. It has no effect on Social Class losses due to changes in status, unless those were brought on by magical effects.

Creates a light that extends outward from the invoker 2-feet radius per PC of the invoker. All Evil supernatural beings must make a Control Resistance once per 10 seconds or be banished to their home plane of origin. Also, any undead creatures are subject to the effects of Turn Undead at 1 practitioner title per 3 PC when entering or reentering the light. The Turn Undead effect (1d4 destroyed, 1d6 turned, etc.) is rolled once at the start of the invocation and then that number is applied to that type until the number is exhausted. So, if Skeletons are milling about and 1d6 of this level creature are supposed to be destroyed. Roll and record the number of Skeletons destroyed in the light or when first encountering the light. Continue doing this for each type of undead as they interact with the light (Decayed Skeleton, Rotting Zombie, Ghoul, etc.).

This invocation restores the invoker to life after death. At the time of invoking, the invoker willfully cedes 1 Will Force point to be used in the renascence. Upon death, the invoker's body is divinely transported to a place deemed safe by the invoker's deity (or a subordinate thereof).  There, the renascence process begins, lasting three days.  At the end of the third day, the invoker awakens with all wounds completely healed, all poisons and diseases cured, and any severed limbs regenerated (including vital areas). If the invoker's death occurs as a result of a destroyed body, the invoker's body will reform at the place chosen by the deity. Once the renascence occurs, the invocation is no longer in effect.  If the invoker's soul is captured, constrained, or otherwise unavailable upon death, the effect of this invocation is delayed until the soul is freed.  A being can only be affected by Renascence once; subsequent uses have no effect.  If the individual dies of old age, this invocation has no effect.

Creates a dimness that extends outward from the invoker 2-feet radius per PC. All who target the invoker must do so at a -4 penalty. All Good supernatural beings must make a Control Resistance once per 10 seconds or be banished to their home plane of origin. Also, any undead creatures are subject to the effects of Control Undead at 1 practitioner title per 3 PC when entering or reentering the shadow.

Allows the caster to create 1 hand of overarching light per 2 PC within the range noted. Each is created separately and may be attached where desired as long as they are within range and not on an unwilling being. This can be placed on a person or their clothes as long as they are a willing target. Each hand has the following properties: 3 Endurance per PC. 1 point of spiritual armor per PC. Strong illumination within a 2-foot radius per PC. Dim illumination within a 5-foot radius per PC. Hand includes a shoulder, arm, forearm, wrist, four fingers and a thumb. Strength and Agility of 15+1 per 4 full PC. Opens, grasps and holds by the invoker's thought for the duration and can hold up to 6 lb. per PC of the invoker. If more is attempted to be held or grasped the hand falls off what it is attached to and vanishes. Can sense evil within its attacking range (10 feet). Is capable of wielding weapons and if desired a magical force-type weapon appears with the hand when it is created. The weapon can be any one-handed weapon that the invoker is also capable of wielding. This weapon is considered +1 per 4 PC of the invoker. If the weapon is dropped it disappears immediately. It will attempt to grasp or attack any evil beings within its sensing range. Other targets can be set by mental thought. If grappling, treat as standard grappling: 10 or better to hit (+ Agility to hit bonus) and then contests of the hand's Strength versus the grasped target's Agility. This is rolled every 5 seconds until either the hand wins twice (pinned) or the target wins and escapes. Any targets struck by the hand or a weapon wielded by the hand must make a Magic Resistance. Failure indicates the target becomes blind, deaf and mute for 1 minute per PC. If a being is grasped by the hand they must make this resistance once per 5 seconds. This effect does not include willing being's it is attached to (unless they are evil). A Control Resistance is also required for each target struck by the hand or a weapon wielded by the hand. If the resistance fails then the being is held for 1 minute per PC. This effect does not include willing being's it is attached to (unless they are evil). Evil beings must make a Control Resistance or be unable to attack or approach within 10 feet of any overarching hand.

Allows the caster to create 1 tendril of overwhelming darkness per 2 PC within the range noted. Each is created separately and may be attached where desired as long as they are within range and not on an unwilling being. This can be placed on a person or their clothes as long as they are a willing target. Each tendril has the following properties: 3 Endurance per PC. 1 point of spiritual armor per PC. Creates a darkness field of 1-foot radius per PC. Creates shadowy field of 3-foot radius per PC. Tendril includes a 1 & 1/2 foot spherical, orb shoulder joint, attached to a 3-feet long tentacle section, attached to a second 2-feet large tentacle & then a shorter tendril 6 inches long that then splits into four flexible, tendril fingers 4 inches in length. Opens, grasps and holds by the invoker's thought for the duration and can hold up to 6 lb. per PC of the invoker. If more is attempted to be held or grasped the tendril falls off what it is attached to and vanishes. Can sense good within its attacking range (10 feet). Is capable of wielding weapons at the attack skill of the invoker, and if desired a magical force-type weapon appears with the hand when it is created. The weapon can be any one-handed weapon that the invoker is also capable of wielding. This weapon is considered +1 per 4 PC of the invoker. If the weapon is dropped it disappears immediately. It will attempt to grasp or attack any good beings within its sensing range. Other targets can be set by mental thought. If grappling, treat as standard grappling: 10 or better to hit (+ Agility to hit bonus) and then contests of the hand's Strength versus the grasped target's Agility. This is rolled every 5 seconds until either the hand wins twice (pinned) or the target wins and escapes. Any targets struck by the hand or a weapon wielded by the hand must make a Magic Resistance. Failure indicates the target becomes blind, deaf and mute for 1 minute per PC. If a being is grasped by the hand they must make this resistance once per 5 seconds. This effect does not include willing being's it is attached to (unless they are good). A Control Resistance is also required for each target struck by the hand or a weapon wielded by the hand. Failure indicates the target is held for 1 minute per PC. This effect does not include willing being's it is attached to (unless they are good). Good beings must make a Control Resistance or be unable to attack or approach within 10 feet of any overwhelming tendril.
Instantly restores any lost physical attribute points that were given up involuntarily.

The invoker directs the ire of their deity at one oppositely aligned being (good if evil, or evil if good). When the invocation completes the target is struck in either the head or chest as determined by the invoker. CHEST: 1d6 damage per 3 PC to the upper torso (thru all normal or magical protections). Fatigue 1 level. Has a 1% chance per 4 PC of the invoker of inducing a heart attack. HEAD: 1d4 damage per 4 PC to the head(thru all normal or magical protections). Mental fatigue 1 level. Breaks all concentration. Has a 1% chance per 4 PC of the invoker of inducing a stroke.

Allows two beings to produce offspring, even if they would otherwise be unable to mate. The combination can be anything permitted by the invoker's deity: two males, two females, mating-incompatible races, etc.  The method of procreation is left up to the imagination (or the Game Master).  When used for two incompatible races, apply the Racial Mixing formulae as though the races were compatible.  This invocation may only be used on two willing beings; if one or both of the targets are unaware or unwilling, the invocation fails. This invocation may be used to allow a barren female or infertile male to conceive. This invocation should not be used for character creation unless the Game Master deems it appropriate.

Gives a special blessing to one other being (cannot be invoked for oneself). This special blessing allows one second chance for a failed situation where chance (dice roll or random circumstance) intervened. The being chooses to use their blessing to have a second chance. The second chance occurs and a new roll or a change in the random circumstance occurs. There is no guarantee that the second chance will succeed and may fail as well or change the outcome in some way that may even be worse. This invocation may only be invoked once per day per target regardless of available uses. Both Deity and GM discretion applies to the situation and circumstance although the blessed being chooses which outcome they would like a second chance to. The answer may be no.

Creates a light that extends outward from the invoker 2-feet radius per PC of the invoker. Any ally in the circle afflicted by poison or disease is immediately cured. All allies regenerate all wounds and even lost limbs at a rate of 1 point per 5 seconds per 2 PC. There is a 1% chance per PC per 10 seconds that a dead former ally within the light will be resurrected. If this is successful the light (and the invocation) immediately fades. The resurrected are able to act immediately and are fully restored. The resurrected are at 2 levels of fatigue for the remainder of that day unless a restore fatigue or like effect is used.

Creates a dimness that extends outward from the invoker 2-feet radius per PC. All who target the invoker must do so at a -4 penalty. All enemies within the shadow have their open wounds fester, taking an additional 1d4+1 per 10 seconds to each wound unless the make a Magic Resistance. Only one Magic Resistance is needed for all wounds. There is a 1% per PC that any blow struck that does at least half the endurance in damage of a body area will maim (make the limb useless) or kill (if in a vital area). If death occurs from this last effect, then the invocation ends immediately.

When the invoker must succeed, this invocation can be used to set their fate, guaranteeing the outcome but marking the invoker for an equally opposite fate at a future point. The invoker adds this invocation to a single action before success is determined and then sets the degree of fate achieved in the action. Then the action is resolved and the invoker now has a mark of fate engraved on their spirit matching that degree. At a future point a similar action by the invoker will fail to the same degree or one of the invoker's enemies will succeed to the same degree selected in the initial action. After this occurs the mark of fate is removed. The invoker cannot escape from the mark of fate save through dying, use of an unlimited wish or by the choice of the deity who granted the invocation (unlikely). Normal wishes, miracles, second chance, dispel divinity, etc., do not apply to remove the mark of fate. The mark of fate will not work against the invoker while they are in an anti-divinity zone but after leaving this the mark of fate returns immediately. Use the table below to aid in determine the degree of success and ultimately the later fate that occurs. FATE-SIMPLE: The action taken succeeds but barely. If trying to hit then they hit but damage must still be rolled, etc. If doing a skill then the skill succeeds but any random portion must still be determined. The mark that follows is either a simple failure for the invoker or a simple opponent success. FATE-CRITICAL: The action critically succeeds. If it is a skill then the skill is considered critical success. If there are random components then a +/-4/ or a +/-20% (whichever is most beneficial) is modified over and above the critical success factors. Maximum random factors are not to be exceeded. The mark that follows is either critical failure for the invoker or a critical success for an opponent. FATE-ABSOLUTE: The action succeeds with the best possible outcome. A called shot is made for maximum damage, a skill succeeds perfectly and all aspects of it are maximized. An attack does maximum possible damage and results of that damage such as the chance to knock out an opponent hit in the head succeed. All random factors and modifiers are maximized. The mark that follows is either absolute failure for the invoker or an absolute success for an opponent.
Instantly restores any lost mental attribute points that were given up involuntarily.

This spell is a lesser form of Imbue Divinity. It behaves exactly as the Imbue Divinity infovation with the following modifications: Imbuement casting time is halved. Will Force costs are halved. One ability/power/usage/effect of the imbued item is gained per title or creature level of the item's user. The invoker decides the order of ability/power/usage/effect gained at the time of Divine Imbuement. The item is considered at base 2 Piety Control per Title or creature level (for all abilities/powers/usages/effects) until it reaches the imbued base Piety Control level and then it does not exceed that. There is no failure chance for an under powered ability/power/usage/effect. If the effect produces nothing at a lower Piety Control, then nothing happens (it just fizzles out).

The invoker selects a target; a being, object (or contiguous area no larger than 100' radius per PC) and then names an effect, either generally such as healing, control, physical enhancement, mental contact, etc. or more specific like the spell slumber. Overly broad categories like all magic, all divine magic, anything a mortal being does to me are not allowed (GM discretion). The being, object or area is now complete immune and unable to be affected by the denial effect category for the duration of the invocation. This is true for both helpful and harmful effects. Avoid protection or anything from an immortal or artifact source bypasses this effect. 1 Will Force can be spent by the invoker or target to make this effect permanent. Areas affected by this invocation block the effect not only against the area but all beings and objects in the area. No more than one denial immunity per 2 full levels/titles from this invocation may be in effect on a being, object or area.

This invocation includes all of the protections of the invocations Guard Body, Personal, Mind and Soul all at the same time. This invocation supersedes each of those and they cannot be in effect while this is in effect, if one of them is in effect when this is invoked they are replaced by this effect. Blocks any attribute, Physical, Mental, Personal or Mystical, from being drained involuntarily. Grants the invoker bodily protection. This effect absorbs up to 2 damage per PC before failing. Whenever the invoker's body would otherwise be damaged, for any instant reason the damage is first applied to the buffer, reducing it by the damaged amount instead of applying that damage to the invoker.  If there is any remaining buffer then it continues to protect the invoker until either the buffer is used up or the duration expires. If at any time the buffer is not enough to stop all of the damage then the remainder of the damage is applied as normal, and is merely reduced by the amount of the remaining buffer and the duration of all effects end. Stops undead transformation effects that would convert the being into a physical only form of undead like a zombie or skeleton. Guards the invoker from being converted into a lycanthrope or involuntary transformation of any kind. If the invoker is already a lycanthrope this can suppress or reverse the change. Guards the invoker from mental attack, and effects which result in control or insanity. If the invoker was already insane or controlled then these effects are removed for the duration of the invocation. The invoker cannot themselves engage in mental combat or contact another being telepathically, nor can they be mentally contacted or probed by others while the invocation is in effect. Stops any effect that would convert the being into a mental only form of undead like a poltergeist or horror. Protects from being converted into any undead that retains a soul. Guards the invoker from being converted into a lycanthrope or involuntary transformation of any kind. If the invoker is already a lycanthrope this can suppress or reverse the change. Guards the invoker from mental attack, and effects which result in control or insanity. If the invoker was already insane or controlled then these effects are removed for the duration of the invocation. The invoker cannot themselves engage in mental combat or contact another being telepathically, nor can they be mentally contacted or probed by others while the invocation is in effect. Stops any effect that would convert the being into a mental only form of undead like a poltergeist or horror. Protects from being converted into any undead that retains a soul.

Creates a light that extends outward from the invoker 2-feet radius per PC of the invoker. All beings in the light can commune at double the normal chance. There is a 1% chance per PC per 10 seconds that an Omen occurs per the Divine Skill omen for each subject prayed about. There is a separate 1% chance per 2 PC per 10 seconds that a Divination can occur for each subject prayed about.

Creates a dimness that extends outward from the invoker 2-feet radius per PC. All who target the invoker must do so at a -4 penalty.  All enemies must make a Magic Resistance or fall prone before the invoker. They must also make a Control Resistance, failure indicates they are in the thrall of the invoker and will kneel or protect the invoker from harm. They are not directly controlled but are more likely to listen and follow any order that involves protecting the invoker so long as their own deaths are not eminent or the danger from the action high. Such cases grant a new Control Resistance immediately to break free.

This invocation allows the invoker to summon the remains of another being to the invoker's current location, provided that the following conditions are met: The invoker must be in possession of an item that belonged to the target being. The target being's remains have not been completely destroyed (GM's discretion). The remains (and any personal belongings within 10 feet of the body) will disappear from their current resting place and appear on a surface area touched by the invoker. The dead being's ghost, if applicable, will be transported along with the remains. If the body is protected in a magical or divine area, or subject to non-detection it cannot be summoned.

Creates a large area that drains the life force slowly from all around it weakening and if they stay long enough likely killing them. Also it blocks good invocations and healing effects as shown. OUTER CIRCLE: 1-mile radius per PC: 1) All non-evil beings must make a Vitality save every 24 hours. If the save is failed then 1 Vitality is lost and 1 level of fatigue is assessed. They do not recover from this effect while in range of the invocation but will recover normally thereafter. If a victim goes below 5 vitality a Will Force save must be made to stay conscious. If the affected being reaches 0 their heart stops and they die. Beings with 15+ Will Force completely ignore these effects. 2) All divine based healing effects and chances are halved. If using a skill all cures and healing are at half chance and do half as much. 3) Wounds in the doomed ground do not heal, unless healed with magic or divine magic. INNER CIRCLE: half mile radius per PC: 1) Same Vitality draining effect as the outer circle but a new save is required. Beings with 15+ Will Force completely ignore these effect. 2) All non-evil beings must make a Control Resistance or lose 1 Will Force. If the being reaches 0 Will Force they lose the will to live and die immediately. If this invocation effect continues or the being is exposed again in the same 24 hour period they do not have to make a new resistance. Only one resistance per day is required. Beings with 20+ Will Force completely ignore this effect. 3) No healing effect divine or magical work at all in this area of effect. 4) Wounds worsen at a rate of 1 point per day to each wound. 5) No good invocations can be cast in this area of effect. Neutral invocations are unaffected. 6) No direct contact with or the summoning of good supernatural beings or deities work in this area of effect. If this invocation is called upon within a haunted grove or permanently cursed ground (per the invocation) the area of effect is multiplied by ten. Hallowed areas, sacred groves or areas blessed for Good are unaffected by this invocation.

Instantly restores any lost mystical attribute points that were given up involuntarily. The invocation will also restore lost magical ability taken through the invocation Revocation or lost by other means such as magic casting loss through high aura casting or magical mishap.

Creates a large area that blocks harmful evil divine magic and slowly drains undead of their negative life force and their will to exist. OUTER CIRCLE: 1-mile radius per PC: 1) All undead (and negative life force beings) with a body  must make a Vitality save every 24 hours. If the save is failed then 1 Vitality is lost and 1 level of fatigue is assessed. They do not recover from this effect while in range of the invocation but will recover normally thereafter. If a victim goes below 5 vitality a Will Force save must be made to continue to function. If the affected being reaches 0 they are destroyed immediately. Undead with 15+ Will Force completely ignore these effects. 2) All divine based healing effects and chances from Evil beings are halved. If using a skill all cures and healing are at half chance and do half as much. 3) Wounds of non-evil beings heal at a rate of 1 point per hour. This does not provide regeneration. INNER CIRCLE: half mile radius per PC: 1) Same undead Vitality draining effect as the outer circle but a new save is required. Undead with 15+ Will Force completely ignore these effect. 2) All undead (and negative life force beings)  beings must make a Control Resistance or lose 1 Will Force. If the being reaches 0 Will Force they lose their ability to remain in undead form and are destroyed. If this invocation effect continues or the undead is exposed again in the same 24 hour period they do not have to make a new resistance. Only one resistance per day is required. Undead with 20+ Will Force completely ignore this effect. 3) No divine based damage effects, skills or invocations used by Evil beings which cause any form of physical harm work within this area of effect. 4) All wounds of non-evil beings or creatures heal at a rate of 1 point per ten minutes. This does not provide regeneration however. 5) No Evil invocations can be cast in this area of effect. Neutral invocations are unaffected. 6) No direct contact with or the summoning of Evil supernatural beings or deities work in this area of effect. If this invocation is called upon within a sacred grove or permanently blessed ground (per the invocation) the area of effect is multiplied by ten. Cursed areas, haunted  groves or areas blasphemed for Evil are unaffected by this invocation.

This invocation has two uses; Create Avatar and Become Avatar. These are as follows: CREATE AVATAR(SELF): Beings over 10th title can create an independent Avatar. This Avatar has all of the invoker's attributes, but no higher than the racial maximums for mortals of that race. They are reduced to 10th title so they have no skills above 10th title and all skills the Avatar is given (below 11th Title) cap at 99%. They have half the additional (non-racial or initial) abilities, powers, and immunities of their original being (rounded up). The Avatar has copies of all the non-artifact magical and non-artifact divine items their original self-carried. The Avatar exists until it is killed (as it is mortal), or returns. When an Avatar dies (or is reabsorbed), all of the duplicated items they carry vanish as well. Duplicate items also teleport back into the Avatar's possession 1 minute after separation from the Avatar. An Avatar can be recalled, even across planes, to oneself, becoming instantly absorbed back into the original being.
